					    #Ythe #yMonks!
					#W(You have been #rWARNED#N!)

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Hill
Rooms.Description:
The grass is green and soft beneath your feet.  The ground rises
slowly to the east, and you feel your calf muscles pleasantly ache.  
Far to the east two small buildings sit atop a small rise.  The air is
fragrant with plantlife, and you reflect on how simple it would be to
ignore anything unpleasant.  Your choices are to climb the rise which
continues east, or to decend to a rather seedy looking park to the
west.

Rooms.Name: Further Up the Hill
Rooms.Description:
The path leads steeply east to what you can clearly see now as a
beautiful, small monastery.  The monastery grounds are particularly
lovely and well tended.  The monks raise a variety of biological life
thought to be extinct.  They care for the plants as the children their
vocation forbids them to have.

Rooms.Name: A Choice of Good or Evil
Rooms.Description:
The path ends here with a tall, wooden fence blocking your view to
the east.  Behind this fence you hear some loud buzzing, snaps, and 
other odd sounds.  South, the cool green arches of the Wiccan monastery
invite you to stop and study with the good monks, perhaps take a meal
in their kitchen.  To the north, hardened criminals have been locked
away to keep the village safe or as punishment for unspeakable crimes.

Rooms.Name: Standing beneath the arch
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the inspiring entryway to the Wiccan Monastery of
Tynstri.  Far above you curves a graceful arch of green marble.  Wise
elves renounce worldly possessions and devote their lives to the study
of the natural order.  The Brothers you will find here have bodies
hardened by their asceticism and wits sharpened by their studies.  Come
here in peace and be enlightened.

Exits.Description: You can faintly make out the outline of the Tynstrian prison.
You see the heavily carved doorway of the monastery.

Rooms.Name: Monastery Hallway East
Rooms.Description:
You are at the eastern end of a long, fairly dark hallway dimly lit
with a faint magical glow.  The floor beneath your feet is a hard,
rough gray stone from a nearby quarry.  It is Brother George's
particular pride (and duty) to keep the stone as clean as if washed by
a daily rainstorm.  The plaster walls and ceiling have been painted
white and hung with instructional verses.  The hallway continues to the
west.  From the east the warmth and fragrance of the monastery kitchen
tempt you.  You can leave the monastery through the tall graceful
arches to the north.

Exits.Description: The graceful green marble arch of the monastery entrance.
Interesting smells and sounds from the kitchen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Wormwood and nutmeg,
Mandrake root and pine,
Bind them together
And luck will be thine.

Rooms.Name: Central Monastery Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hallway continues here, its simple clean gray stone floor and
whitewashed walls are very restful.  The Wiccan brothers labor long
hours in their garden and in the surrounding forest, studying the
relationships between nature and magic.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues both east and west.
The hallway continues both east and west.

Rooms.Name: Western Monastery Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the western end of the monastery.  A large window to
the west captures each evening's sunset.  The flowers you see planted in
the patch of garden reflect the sunset colors and you sense the
Brothers' struggle for harmony.

Exits.Description: The hallway heads towards the kitchen.
You hear sounds of weeping coming from the cell to the south.

Rooms.Name: Brother Russ's Cell
Rooms.Description:
Brother Russ is the master herbalist of this sect.  The many charts
of rare and common plants of field and forest obscure the whitewashed
walls. Twigs, leaves, and small seedlings cover the narrow oak table
under the large, southern facing window.  Looking out the window, you
see a beautifully planned garden, with some very odd-looking plants.
Your only path from here is north to the hallway.

Exits.Description: A plain wooden door blocks your view of the hallway.

Rooms.Name: Brother John's Cell
Rooms.Description:
Brother John sleeps in this small, dark cell.  There is no clue to
the personality of the owner inside - the walls are plain and bare and 
the small table has only a comb and brush and a small piece of  
parchment. The view from the single, small bare window at the southern 
end of the room is blocked by a small stand of trees.  This has the 
effect of keeping the occupant's focus either internal, or on the 
intrigue of nature as revealed in the pattern of bark. 
It is no wonder Brother John feels like weeping at times.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bide the Wiccan Law ye must,
In perfect love and perfect trust.
Eight words the Wiccan Rede fulfill:
An' ye harm none, do what ye will.

What ye send forth comes back to thee
So ever mind the law of three.
Follow this with mind and heart,
Merry ye meet, and merry ye part.
There is writing on it!

Despite watery blotches on the paper, you are able to decipher the
following words:

     "I can never hope for forgiveness or absolution.  I should never
      have allowed it.  We are to preserve nature, not enhance it.  
      The experiments with the insects should never have happened.  
      I can only hope they can be confined within the monastery grounds."

Beyond this point, the writing becomes too blurred to read.

Rooms.Name: Monastery Dormitory
Rooms.Description:
This large room serves as a dormitory for the newest monks.  The
room appears nearly empty during the day, as the monks roll their 
mats out on the floor at night, and roll them into a bundle for the day.  The
room's only light is the daylight or moonlight/starlight that filters
in through the narrow clerestory windows which line the south wall.

Exits.Description: The monastery hallway glistens whitely north of here.
The dormitory is a large room.

Rooms.Name: Eastern End of the Monk's Dormitory
Rooms.Description:
The young monks who inhabit this room leave little trace of their
existence when they are not here.  The room is bare except for a pile
of rolled-up sleeping mats in one corner.  The walls are painted white,
a faint contrast with the cold grey of the stone floor.  The room
continues to the west.

Exits.Description:
The monastery gardens where all novices study and work lie to the east
of here, through the wooden doors.

Rooms.Name: Vine-covered Trellis
Rooms.Description:
A large trellis marks the entrance to the monastery gardens.  The
trellis is tall enough and wide enough for a small group of the tallest
of the monks to easily pass beneath.  It is covered with a dark green
vine with small, glossy leaves.

Exits.Description: A dazzling display of humongous white flowers.
The monks dormitory lies through a simple wooden door west.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - White
Rooms.Description:
You feel the scent of hundreds of white roses almost as a physical
assault.  Everywhere you look you see white roses of every variety.
There are climbing roses on trellises and tea roses with long stems on
large bushes, creamy white roses and snow white roses, and everywhere a
heavy sweet scent.

Rooms.Name: Wiccan Rainbow Gardens - Purple
Rooms.Description:
You are walking in the gardens of the Wiccan Monastery of Tynstri.
There is a path of sorts, formed from relatively smooth flat rocks 
gathered from some streambed.  Brightly colored flowers border the path.  In
this section of the garden, the flowers are all shades of deep purple,
lilac and violet.  The garden continues north and south.

Exits.Description: Shades of blue tempt you to explore.
The brightness of white nearly blinds you.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - Deep Purple Moves into Blue
Rooms.Description:
The deep purple flowers north of here are gradually shading into
deep blue, powder blue and aqua. The Wiccan love of rainbows has been
reflected in the garden plantings.  Blue-stars blossom next to blue
bugles and  forget-me-nots.

Exits.Description: To the north, the blue becomes green.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - succulent green
Rooms.Description:
Here, the monks raise aloe.  The aloe is used to treat dragon-burns
and other injuries.  The aloe grow in small spiked clumps and on tall 
trees with no bark.  Besides the succulents, coleus, Bells-of-Ireland,
Limelight and green zinnias blossom here.

Exits.Description: North, the garden warms into the colors of sunset.
To the south, the garden deepens to blue.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - Sunset colors
Rooms.Description:
This part of the garden is so bright that you feel warm just
admiring the plants.  Hollyhocks and daisies, Iceland poppies and tall
sunflowers, miniature marigolds and black-eyed susan vines all in
shades from sunny yellow to a deep burnt orange.  All flourish with the
monks' careful magic.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - Red
Rooms.Description:
Red and pink flowers cover this part of the garden.  Fuschia drip
from pots hung on the monastery wall.  Snapdragons snap at your heels.
Monkey flowers make faces at you and foxglove, poppies, patience and
cockscomb all add to the dull red, bright red, cherry red, deep pink
... all shades of red.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow vegetables - Orange to yellow
Rooms.Description:
Bright orange and yellow vegetables and fruits fill this part of the
garden.  Pumpkins of all sizes - many large enough to hold an adult elf
- bask in the sunshine and grow even larger.  Yellow squash and pale
yellow bananas grow side by side.  Yellow tomatoes grow on bushes on
the eastern side of the path, bosc pears on trees on the west.  Carrots
wave their greens at you from under the pear trees.

Rooms.Name: Greens
Rooms.Description:
Lettuces and cabbages grow in abundance here in the shade of the
monastery wall.  Leaf lettuces line up by head lettuces.  Cabbages grow
in firm round balls next to tall dark leafy kale and mustard greens.
Green beans drip from their vines, ready to be harvested.

Rooms.Name: Rainbow Gardens - Blueberries and Boysandberries
Rooms.Description:
Berries in all shades of blue and purple grow on bushes and thorny
vines, straining for sunshine in this part of the garden just off the
monastery kitchen.  Blueberries, boysenberries and blackberries are all
ready to be picked.  Trees laden with enormous deep purple plums reach
for the sky, and huge aubergines grow at your feet.  All the plants are
unusual in their size.  They all seem to glow with magic.

Exits.Description: A patch of white vegetables lies south of here.

Rooms.Name: Blindingly white onions
Rooms.Description:
Enormous vegetables in many shades of white fill this part of the
gardens.  Giant heads of cauliflower wink at you from their nest of
green, and large white onions peek shyly from their barely-covering
layer of soil.  Potatoes, white radishes and daikon all seem to
flourish here in large sizes.

Rooms.Name: Hold your nose
Rooms.Description:
To every thing there is a season, and for the pile that you find
here, that season is past.  The Wiccan monks carefully recycle all of 
their left over clippings, herbs, vegetables, flowers, and other organic
matter in an enormous compost heap that one of the strong monks tends.
As you bat the enormous flies away from your face you debate entering
the monastery kitchen, west of you, or exploring the gardens to the
north.

Exits.Description: You see enormous white vegetables in scattered plantings.
The monastery kitchen is off to the west.

Rooms.Name: Monastery Kitchen
Rooms.Description:
The monastery kitchen is warm and welcoming, fragrant with the odors
of fish baking in herbs freshly gathered from the forest.  Elven chefs 
are widely known, and the monks have long held that a strong body, like 
a strong mind, must be properly nurtured.  The kitchen is spotlessly
white and clean.  The walls are lined with cabinets that hold foods and
herbs, medicinal and savory, grown by the monks who live here.

Exits.Description: Smells of decay seep through the heavy door.
The passage to the monks' rooms begins west of here.
Down the stairs to an intoxicating smell

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like a long slit.

Rooms.Name: Monastery Wine Cellar
Rooms.Description:
A steep, narrow stairway winds round and round, finally leaving you
in an unlit, cool cellar, redolent with the fruit of the vine.  Around 
you an endless army of green glass stores wines of many colors and 
scents.  The cellar continues to the east, or you may wish to return to 
the kitchen via the stairs.

Rooms.Name: Wine Cellar - East
Rooms.Description:
At this end of the wine cellar you can often see Brother Dionysos
and the Wiccan winemaker conferring about the properties of the wines.
Around you are large oaken barrels, each with a tap in the end near the
bottom.  The dirt floor is cold beneath your feet, and the earthy smell
adds an overlay to the pungent odor of spilt wine and candle wax.

Rooms.Name: Off the beaten path
Rooms.Description:
Yet another small clearing in the elven forest at once frightens and
enchants you. A heavy fall of vines from one of the many tall trees is
a delight to the eyes, yet there is something very sinister about their
long sharp thorns.  You can go back to the path south of here.  Trees
north, east and west block the path.

Exits.Description: A tiny trail through the forest is south of here.

Rooms.Name: A tiny trail
Rooms.Description:
A tiny trail leads through the forest here.  The way is so narrow
that you wonder if it is a path made by small forest animals rather than
elves.  It bends sharply here, and you must choose between following
the trail west or south, or head north into a tiny clearing.

Exits.Description: A small clearing in the forest.
A more travelled path appears to be west of here.

Rooms.Name: Small dark path through the forest
Rooms.Description:
A small dark path leads east, north and south from here.  The path
is so faint that you wonder if you are just imagining it in hopes that 
you are not lost.  From the south you hear a roar.

Exits.Description: The tiny clearing looks like a good spot for an ambush.
You hear the roar of rushing water

Rooms.Name: A perfect place for an ambush!
Rooms.Description:
This small clearing appears to be the perfect setup for an ambush.
If you stand very still you can hear soft, stealthy sounds from behind 
the trees that block the exits north, east and south from here.  
Probably not a good place to just hang...

Exits.Description: You see a tiny trail wending its way through the forest.

Rooms.Name: Path to the Prison
Rooms.Description:
This path looks sadly unused and neglected.  Weeds thrive along the
edges and have begun to grow across the middle of the path.  The loud
buzzing of insects thriving on the monastery garden plants competes for
your attention with a thrummm of activity which is somehow underneath
your feet.

Exits.Description: A dark and dismal place looms ahead
In the distance you see the green arches of the monastery.

Rooms.Name: Prison
Rooms.Description:
The dark gray building seems out of place here amidst the verdant
greens of Tynstri.  There are heavy chains covering the doors.  There
are no windows.  There is a small sign on the door.  You look down the 
path south of here and realize that that is a safer place to be.

Exits.Description: An overgrown dirt path leads south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You read, "Out hunting dragons."  There is something further written in
tiny, barely legible print.

If u c some1 in an oranj jumpsuit with "Tynstri Prison" in black
writing
on the back ... run!

Mobs.Name: closet monster m6700
Mobs.LongDescription: A dark closet monster hides, waiting for some dummy to open the door.
Mobs.Description:
A vague black shape, hiding in the back of the closet, glowing eyes
peeking out at you from a half-opened closet door, the closet monster
lurks.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%90 close door;%5 cackle;%59 snarl;%1 curse

Mobs.Name: under-the-bed monster m6701
Mobs.LongDescription: The under-the-bed monster has strong hands that GRAB you!!
Mobs.Description:
Annie's under-the-bed monster is the stuff of nightmares.  He has long
sharp teeth to tear your flesh and long, strong arms that whip out from
under the bed, fast as lightning, to drag you underneath and EAT YOU
UP!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote suddenly #rsnakes#W out from under the bed and makes a fast 
grab for your ankles !!!

Mobs.Name: aarakocra
Mobs.LongDescription: The aarakocra soars swiftly by high above you.
Mobs.Description:
Were you to stand next to him, you would see this bird-man is about the
height of a 12 year old human, however his wingspan is nearly 4 times
his height.  What makes this an especially dangerous bird is his
ability to swoop suddenly and rapidly down at you from the sky.  From
his powerful feet with the long, agile talons to his sharp beak, you
can see he is an adversary worthy of the finest knight.

Mobs.Name: gryphon
Mobs.LongDescription: The gryphon flies at you, claws and fangs poised for attack!
Mobs.Description:
A sleek and powerful cat, with claws as long as your fingers and
powerful jaws lined with sharp teeth.  The gryphon has a pair of small
but mighty wings giving her great mobility.  Her thick, dense fur is an
excellent protection against attack, and her fearsome appearance is
enough to scare off all but the most determined of predators.

Mobs.Name: vulture
Mobs.LongDescription: Circling above you, the vulture patiently waits to attack.
Mobs.Description:
The vulture's feathers are black as night in a coal mine.  He circles
lazily over the landscape, looking for the dead, but he is not averse
to helping the death process along.  He has a beak which hooks sharply
and he uses it to rip flesh from dying bodies.  He watches you with
evilly glowing golden eyes.

Mobs.Name: wyvern
Mobs.LongDescription: The wyvern flickers his forked tongue at you menacingly.
Mobs.Description:
A tall, tough-skinned gray-green dragon with small, leathery wings, the
wyvern is all sharp points.  His teeth are those of a carnivore who
rips bites off his prey then swallows them whole.  There is a
protective ridge of spines down his back and along his short tail.
Even his wing tips end in sharp claws.  The wyvern snarls and attacks
everything he sees.

Mobs.Name: master ranger MrRanger
Mobs.LongDescription: The Master Ranger ceaselessly roams the kingdom, fighting evil.
Mobs.Description:
The Master Ranger is noble, fearless, shiningly strong and brave.  He
is ruthless in his attempts to root out evil.  He is an elf of the
forest, and dressed to blend in with his surroundings in deep green and
chocolate suede over his tough mithril chainmail.  When he meets your
eyes you fear he will see every wicked thought within you, and you
quiver before his might.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 flex;%2 say FEAR the Mighty Ranger's wrath!!

Mobs.Name: elf forest-dweller
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf nervously watches the sky as he hurries along.
Mobs.Description:
With his quiver of arrows slung across his back and a bow in one hand,
the elf looks ready for danger.  These are perilous times that try
elves' patience!  Not only have the dragons taken up hunting elves for
fun, but there seem to be a lot of other creatures who have taken up
the same sport!  Of course, the elves, having good on their side, will
win.  But at what cost?
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 wrestle

Mobs.Name: elf woman female
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf looks worriedly back at her home.
Mobs.Description:
A dainty female elf, with long curly blond hair and an air of worry.
She has had to leave her children alone while she goes to the healer's
for some coltsfoot for her cough.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 headache

Mobs.Name: ancient elder elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The wizened elf remembers dragon plagues of old.
Mobs.Description:
The elder is old, even by elven standards.  He remembers well the days
of the last infestation of dragons, and how so many of his friends died
in that glorious battle.

Mobs.Name: Henrietta Hennapy elf herbalist
Mobs.LongDescription: Henrietta looks up at you from the pot she is stirring.
Mobs.Description:
Henrietta Hennapy is a very very very ancient elf, source of much of
the knowledge of magic of this generation of elves.  Bring her a couple
of bat's wings and a dragon claw, a bit of pixie blood and she can make
a potion that will make you nearly invulnerable - for a time, at least.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles indulgently at you.

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: The charcoal black cat ignores your insignificant presence.
Mobs.Description:
An exceptionally large cat, her coat shines with good health.  She is
sleek and well muscled, evidence of nights spent on the prowl in the
forest.  You have seen an abundance of birds in the forest, but all
seem too large for a cat to kill.  But then, this is no ordinary cat.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr

Mobs.Name: apprentice Tamric
Mobs.LongDescription: Tamric rushes to do as Henrietta asks.
Mobs.Description:
Tamric studied plants for many years with the Wiccan monks in the
village below, but he became disturbed by the way they were beginning
to "improve" on nature.  He begged Henrietta to allow him to study with
her.  Tamric is a wiry elf of medium height.  His eyes are hazel,
unusual for an elf, and his hair a tawny gold.

Mobs.Name: dragon purple
Mobs.LongDescription: The gigantic purple dragon settles comfortably on the flimsy branch.
Mobs.Description:
The gigantic dragon is a lovely shade of purple - a deep red shade
almost fuchsia.  His wings are huge but look very fragile - a gauzy web
of prism-like colors.  There is a muted pattern of stars covering his
huge body, discernible only by their faint glow.  Around his neck, the
dragon wears a large heart-shaped locket.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 bounce

Mobs.Name: dragon topaz
Mobs.LongDescription: The topaz dragon casually knocks over a small tree with his tail.
Mobs.Description:
The glowing yellow topaz dragon is beautiful.  But clumsy.  He is a
bit awkwardly proportioned for a dragon with an enormous tail and
relatively small body.  His softly glowing yellow topaz skin contrasts
brightly  with the sharp purple ridges rippling down his back and
across his tail.  He has painted his claws a bright cherry red.

Mobs.Name: dragon aquamarine
Mobs.LongDescription: A small aquamarine dragon darts at you, claws flying at your face.
Mobs.Description:
This dragon is small, as dragons go, but very fierce.  She is a pale
sea green with deep purple eyes and long dark eyelashes.  She has
strong, leathery wings and is very agile when airborne.  She is, of
course, a fire breather, but her long, sharp teeth and talons make this
ability almost unnecessary.

Mobs.Name: dragon ice
Mobs.LongDescription: The ice dragon chills you with her stare.
Mobs.Description:
Made of cold clear ice from an enchanted forest lake, the ice dragon
has a heart as cold as her long, smooth body.  Her eyes are a clear ice
blue, and she moves with agility for one of her size.  She stares at
you as if to say, "Fear me, mortal."
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote freezes you with her stare.

Mobs.Name: gold dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The shining gold dragon dazzles your eyes.
Mobs.Description:
A powerful dragon made of  gold and decorated with a king's ransom in
precious gems.  The dragon moves smoothly on air and on land, and his
graceful strength makes him a formidable adversary.  Like the other
dragons infesting Tynstri, he has a fearsome first attack with fire.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 boast;%2 hum

Mobs.Name: firedragon dragon fire
Mobs.LongDescription: The bright red and orange dragon glows with the fire of his birth.
Mobs.Description:
The firedragon glows with the heat of the fire whence he emerged.
Great tongues of fire leap from his open maw, and small fires start
with his every touch.  He moves among the trees, leaving death and
destruction in his wake.

Mobs.Name: white dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: What you thought was a cloud turns out to be a large white dragon.
Mobs.Description:
This enormous dragon is a pure white in color and at first you want to
believe that it is a cloud come to life.  His outlines are obscured by
the white smoke billowing from his flared nostrils, and a quick,
darting tongue of flame burns the leaves off nearby trees.  The
dragon's enormous tail is covered with long, dense white fur that
belies the whiplike strength with which the dragon wields it.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 bungy;%1 charge

Mobs.Name: honor guard Honora
Mobs.LongDescription: Honora watches you suspiciously, honor-bound to protect the throne.
Mobs.Description:
Her long straight blond hair braided and secured to her head, Honora is
proud of her position as part of the elf king's honor guard.  She looks
at you from her serious blue eyes, watching you to be sure you don't
try to steal or defile anything belonging to her king.

Mobs.Name: guard honor petra
Mobs.LongDescription: Petra stands immobile, staring stonily ahead of her.
Mobs.Description:
Petra is an exceptionally strong elf, dressed in shining white armor.
Her normal job is simply to oversee the small groups of young elves who
come in awe to see the home of their king, but if the visitors are
intent on theft or harm she is quite capable of defending the throne.

Mobs.Name: Purity honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Purity paces about the king's quarters, watching you suspiciously.
Mobs.Description:
Purity has waist length honey golden blond hair with deep green eyes.
Her ears are a trifle too round on top to be perfect.  She has a small,
pointed chin and a wide smile with deep dimples on either side.  She is
often reprimanded by the stricter members of her troop for humming to
herself, but she is usually too cheerful to mind.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Wonder when he'll be back.

Mobs.Name: Chastity honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Chastity idly polishes gold fixings and the throne.
Mobs.Description:
Chastity has the face of an angel, with delicate, pale features, a
sweet smile and nicely pointed ears.  Her fair, transparent skin
readily reveals her slightest blush, and she is easily embarrassed.
Her hair is an ice blond, so pale that in some light it looks white.
In spite of her apparent fragility she is quite strong, and an awesome
opponent.

Mobs.Name: Patience honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Patience would rather be out fighting dragons than waiting idly.
Mobs.Description:
Patience would actually rather be doing anything than standing here
shepherding little children through sightseeing tours.  She is very
active and seems to be in constant motion.  Her hands are ever moving,
readjusting her uniform, straightening the many objets d'art which
clutter the throne room.

Mobs.Name: Faith honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Faith stands quietly by the throne, prepared for intruders.
Mobs.Description:
Aptly named, Faith will stand faithfully at her post for a decade, if
need be.  The only non-elf in the honor guard, Faith is half-elven and
half-gnome, the result of what her mother thinks of as an "unfortunate
incident" that happened on an adventure far away.  She is tiny for an
elf, with bright red hair that she keeps hidden beneath the white
helmet of her uniform.  Her green eyes look watchfully at you.

Mobs.Name: ruby dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The blood red ruby dragon glows with a deep inner fire.
Mobs.Description:
The same deep red as the heart of a ruby, this dragon glows with an
inner fire.  Constantly flying the Tynstrian forests, gloatingly free of
the dark cave of her birth, the dragon heartlessly turns elven homes to
burnt coals.  She blows a long tongue of flame, filled with pleasure at
the color and the warmth.  About her neck she wears a silver id chain.

Mobs.Name: rats rat
Mobs.LongDescription: The tower rats squeak "eep!" as they skitter from under your feet.
Mobs.Description:
Red eyes glowing in the dark, the small tower rat cowers at your
approach, nose twitching as he catches your scent.  The rat has a long
pinkish tail devoid of the black fur that covers the  rest of his body.
His yellowing rodent teeth are always sharp.

Mobs.Name: emerald dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The deep green emerald dragon seems to blend in with the forest.
Mobs.Description:
At first you think the sunlight on the leaves has made an unusually
interesting pattern.  Then you realize that what is facing you is a
dragon made of an enormous, glowing gemstone.  At 40' tall (over 6m) he
towers over you, and glares greenly down at you as if you were a small
snack.

Mobs.Name: crystal dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The crystal dragon softly scorches you with a blast of steam.
Mobs.Description:
A very young dragon, as dragons go, the crystal dragon is still trying
out her wings (and her fire).  Sometimes when she means to burn a
village, she only succeeds in helping light a fire in a fireplace.
Other times she sneezes and starts a forest fire.  Very self-conscious
(for a dragon), you will frequently see her polishing her crystalline
scales.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%05 emote carefully polishes her scales.; %5 fashion; %2 hum

Mobs.Name: amethyst dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The amethyst dragon unfurls her pale violet wings, stretching.
Mobs.Description:
The amethyst dragon glows with the pale violet colors of early dawn.
About 25' (8m) tall from the ends of her deep purple claws to the top
of the rigid ruffle of points that extends from her small head, the
amethyst dragon is small as dragons go.  Her eyes glow a dark crimson
from their deeply placed sockets.  Her wings stretch 50' from pointed
wing tip to pointed wing tip.

Mobs.Name: shadow dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The shadow dragon is a vague threatening shape against the sky.
Mobs.Description:
The shadow dragon is not often seen, but his awesome presence is often
felt as clearly as one feels the imminence of rainfall.  He is the most
massive of dragons.  His color is the dark gray of thunderclouds, and
his breath is like lightning.  A king of dragons, he is usually content
to wait for excitement to find him.  He has little taste for hunting.

Mobs.Name: banshee
Mobs.LongDescription: Your mind screams with pain as the banshee wails.
Mobs.Description:
Undead feminine spirit or strange, live woman?  When she begins to
scream you realize in horror it is a banshee.  She is tall and slender
with an athletic grace.  Her hair is a blue so dark it appears black,
making her pallid face appear ghostly.  Her playful smile reveals
sharply pointed teeth, and as she reaches out a thin pale hand to you,
you recoil from the talons at the ends of each finger.

Mobs.Name: dwarf woodcutter
Mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven woodcutter swings his axe with great strength and agility.
Mobs.Description:
With all of the power of the dreaded ogre, but none of the height or
the smell, this particular dwarf owes his overdeveloped muscles to his
preoccupation with cutting down the forest of Tynstri. Cutting down
forests is something he has done all his life.  Lately, however, he's
been disturbed to notice the trees have started to bleed when cut.

Mobs.Name: adventurer elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The tiny elf strides along the path to adventure.
Mobs.Description:
He is a fairly tiny elf, but full of energy and determination.  He grew
up during the famine which followed the last great dragon infestation,
when so many elves died of starvation.  He has heard rumors that the
dragons are once again breeding, and has set out upon an adventure to
discover the truth.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%2 emote sings as he walks along, "#yMacho, macho elf!  I wanna be a 
macho elf! #W"

Mobs.Name: dancing wood elf
Mobs.LongDescription: Wildly dancing, the wood elf barely notices your presence.
Mobs.Description:
A jaunty little elf with skin the color of bright autumn maple leaves
and hair a golden honey color, the elf has lost himself in his joyous
dance.  It would be heartless of you to disturb him.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%3 dance; %3 tango elf

Mobs.Name: wood elf drinking
Mobs.LongDescription: The wood elf gives you a sly, slow, slightly tipsy wink.
Mobs.Description:
Wood elves have a reputation for being carefree and merry making.  This
elf is doing his best to earn that reputation.  He has filled his bota
with a rich red wine purloined from the wine cellar in Tynstri, and he
has been drinking freely from it for several hours now.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 stare; %2 snap;%5 hiccup;%1 wink

Mobs.Name: wood elf listener
Mobs.LongDescription: The young wood elf listens raptly to the tales of long ago.
Mobs.Description:
Dressed in ragged but colorful clothing, the young elf lives for now
and for pleasure.  She is merry by nature, and devoted to pleasure.
She is particularly enchanted by stories of old, of brave knights and
wicked dragons, beautiful princesses and noble heroes.

Mobs.Name: singing elf wood
Mobs.LongDescription: The pretty wood elf's merry voice sings of good times and good friends.
Mobs.Description:
The singer has cut short her pale blond hair and dyed it many colors
with the carefully gathered flowers and barks of her forest elf kin.
Using pine resins, she has formed it into interesting sworls and spikes
about her head.  She sings loud and happy songs and can often be found
trailing through the forest with a small following of admirers.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%3 airguitar

Mobs.Name: storyteller wood elf
Mobs.LongDescription: A long bearded elf tells of fierce battles with mighty dragons.
Mobs.Description:
The old wood elf has a long thin beard that trails to his knees.  He
tells a story to an enchanted audience.  The story recounts the days of
the last dragon invasion, when an evil mage brought dragon eggs to the
caverns beneath the lake in the Tynstri forest.  The mage believed he
would be able to control dragons raised from hatchlings and thus have
the enormous power of dragons at his command.

Mobs.Name: gnome walker
Mobs.LongDescription: The gnome scientist searches for the fabled Cave of the Dragons.
Mobs.Description:
Only 4' tall (about 1m.), the gnome is not quite as stout as those of
his race tend to be.  He is strong from his treks through the woods,
looking for dragon droppings.  This particular scientist is on the
trail of the dragon outlet.  He knows that dragons breed and raise
their young deep below the surface of the earth.  He hopes to find the
outlet to their cave and block it, ending the current scourge of
dragons.

Mobs.Name: goblin gobble-un
Mobs.LongDescription: The gobble-un eyes you thinking, "Roasted or raw?"  He says, "Wanna PK?"
Mobs.Description:
Short, squat, bald and green, this branch of the goblin family went
their own way some hundreds of years ago. Sometimes they shine up their
pointy ears with walnut oil and pretend (to each other) to be elves.
This particular gobble-un is HUNGRY for ADVENTURERS!  (like you)  He
waits impatiently, eager for someone to foolishly accept his challenge
and become his dinner.  Just remember ...The gobble-un 'll get you, ef
you don't watch out!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 drool;%1 grimace;%1 curse

Mobs.Name: lynx
Mobs.LongDescription: The graceful lynx crouches in a tree, ready to pounce.
Mobs.Description:
A beautiful tawny yellow coat covers this graceful cat from twitching
nose and whiskers to the end of her very short tail.  She's usually to
be found napping high in a tree during the daytime, safe from the
wolves roaming the forest.  At night she is the consummate hunter,
pulling down small deer and even dwarves.

Mobs.Name: sasquatch woman female
Mobs.LongDescription: The large furry female looks warily at you before moving quietly away.
Mobs.Description:
This sasquatch woman is smaller than her mate, who is foraging nearby
in the forest.  She is about 2 metres (6'8") tall, and her dense black
fur provides protection from the thorns and twigs of her environment.
A peaceful creature, she means you no harm.

Mobs.Name: sasquatch man male
Mobs.LongDescription: The sasquatch man hums quietly to himself as he moves about the forest.
Mobs.Description:
Tall enough to be of the giant race, the sasquatch is nevertheless a
separate species.  He has a large, very muscular body covered with a
thin soft brown fur, which has begun to silver around his head and down
his back.  He moves quietly about the forest.

Mobs.Name: wood sprite
Mobs.LongDescription: The tiny wood sprite smothers a giggle so he can surprise you.
Mobs.Description:
Eyes sparkling with mischief, the tiny wood sprite loves to tease.  He
hides, invisible to normal folk, waiting for the unwary.  This
particular wood sprite is dressed all in green so as to be all but
invisible even to mages.

Mobs.Name: alpha wolf female werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: Powerful and cunning, the she wolf bares her teeth to warn you off.
Mobs.Description:
The female alpha wolf is sleek, strong and fast.  Moving, she is a gray
blur against the landscape. Still, her deep gray fur glows with health
and with the deep magic that makes her a shape shifter.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: alpha wolf male werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: Snarling low in his throat, the alpha male werewolf prepares to leap.
Mobs.Description:
Ice blue eyes stare back at you unblinkingly from a silver gray face.
You sense his pride in his leadership of the pack, and the strength of
body and of mind that has made him the leader.  His thick silver-gray
fur provides protection against both cold and sharp-toothed predators.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: curious werewolf wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The sleek black wolf sniffs curiously at the air, intrigued.
Mobs.Description:
This werewolf's thick fur is a deep, rich black, matching her dark
eyes.  On moonless nights she moves quietly through the forest, unseen
and unheard by normal souls.  Her keen senses pick up on slight
variations in color, texture, noise and scent, and this world has an
endless fascination for her.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote sniffs curiously at you.;%1 nose wolf;%1nose werewolf;
%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: ferocious werewolf wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The ferocious werewolf crouches low, preparing to SPRING at you.
Mobs.Description:
The werewolf looks back at you hungrily, ready to rip out your throat
for the pleasure of the kill.  His long front canines are quite sharp
and capable of doing a great deal of damage to your tender skin.  Fight
or flee?  He is too swift for you to outrun, but those same muscles
will make him an awesome opponent.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf

Mobs.Name: wolf cub werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The werewolf cub snarls bravely at you, baring his mighty fangs.
Mobs.Description:
Although younger and less powerful than the adults of his pack, the
werewolf cub makes up for this with sheer outrageous courage.  He will
attack any prey with the rest of his pack, no matter how much larger or
stronger it is.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: hunter wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The lean hungry wolf swifly but silently stalks her prey.
Mobs.Description:
Injured in a fight with one of the tawny-coated lynxes that inhabit
this forest, the wolf was left behind by her pack when they moved on to
a less crowded area of the forest.  She has been hunting on her own
ever since, not always successfully.  Her coat is shaggy and dull, and
there is a mean, hungry look in her eyes.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote snarls viciously at you, baring long sharp teeth.;%2 howl

Mobs.Name: lame wolf hobbling
Mobs.LongDescription: The three-legged werewolf snarls viciously at you.
Mobs.Description:
One of the dangers of living near the dragon caves is the inevitability
of occasional encounters with dragonkind.  While the large, mature
dragons live mostly higher up in the trees and the young dragons live
deep in the caves, during the migrations of the adolescent dragons some
occasionally try their new skills out on the forest floor.  This poor
werewolf was one of the casualties of a mis-directed blast of fire.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: Baby Blue dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The big baby blue dragon plays quietly with her toys.
Mobs.Description:
Baby Blue is a lovely soft pastel shade of blue, with deeper blue wings
ending in indigo wingtips.  Although still an infant, it's clear that
she will be a very large dragon when full grown.  She lacks the
go-for-the-throat attitude of her hatch mates, however, and may never
take advantage of her size.

Mobs.Name: Bubba dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Bubba can't fly yet, but he can roll over you like a mighty rockfall.
Mobs.Description:
One enormous dragon!  Not anywhere near his full growth yet, Bubba
towers over all the other hatchlings from his clutch.  His dragon
master tells him if he keeps eating the elf cook's cream puffs at the
rate he's going he won't be able to fit out the exit tunnel of the
cave.  Bubba's not sure that's such a big deal.  He's not sure he will
ever be able to fly.  And there is something to be said for a life
spent eating cream puffs!

Mobs.Name: cave bat
Mobs.LongDescription: Is this hairy scary cave bat a vampire?  Hard to tell!
Mobs.Description:
Hanging upside down from the ceiling of this small cave is an enormous
bat.  The bat is so big its head is hanging down near your groin.  It
has large leathery wings covered in a light fur, and you notice a
slight drool coming from it's mouth.  You wonder what a bat this size
would eat.  You hope it isn't you.

Mobs.Name: Chucky mannequin doll
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil doll grins at you, saying, "I'm b-a-a-a-c-k!"
Mobs.Description:
An evil drow mage once sent a truckload of these dolls to infest a
small elven orphanage.  On one of his rare excursions outside the cave,
Sneaker stole the dolls and brought them back to the dragon nursery.
The Chucky dolls are wooden mannequins about the height of a small
wolf.  They are very vicious, and very brutal when they don't get their
own way.  Unfortunately for them, the dragons use the really nasty ones
as target practice for their fireballs.  Nothing warms a dragon's heart
like the sight of a Chucky doll going up in flames.

Mobs.Name: dragon ghost ghostly
Mobs.LongDescription: A faintly discernible image shimmers in the air beside you.
Mobs.Description:
A chill blows over you, despite your enclosed surroundings.  You can
feel it even in your bones.  The great dragon, last of his clan, swore
as he died to haunt those who would destroy his kind.  He does indeed
inspire a mind-numbing fear.

Mobs.Name: dragon mummy
Mobs.LongDescription: The dragon mummy wanders endlessly through dark and lonely caves.
Mobs.Description:
Rather than being cremated, as is the custom for dragons who have
passed on to the greater glory, this poor dragon's relatives wanted to
keep his beautiful dragon body around for posterity.  They had it
mummified and embalmed by the funeral home owned by Howard.  The staff
boasted great experience, having embalmed most of those now buried
under the Midgaard Chapel.  Unfortunately, the staff was corrupt, inept
and downright evil.  The mummy is doomed to walk the caves of its
birthplace until someone puts it (at least temporarily) out of its
misery.

Mobs.Name: skeleton dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The dragon skeleton creaks eerily as it wanders the caves.
Mobs.Description:
What is it searching for in its endless wandering through the caves of
its homeland?  Nobody seems to know, but the young dragons have learned
to ignore it.  Except when it tries to climb in bed with them at night,
of course.  *shiver*

Mobs.Name: zombie dragon
Mobs.LongDescription:
The zombie dragon shuffles along, filling the cave with a ghostly
smoke.
Mobs.Description:
Zed the Zombie.  Not too frightening, is he?  Just because he is
MASSIVELY larger than you, has a mouthful of glistening white teeth and
could crush you with one swipe of his tail is no reason to panic!  (Or
is it? :)

Mobs.Name: undead dragon GUD
Mobs.LongDescription: The GUD charges at you with a quiet roar of displeasure!
Mobs.Description:
The Great Undead Dragon (known in the dragon nursery as the GUD) is
doomed to walk the trail of the undead through the Great Dragon Crypt
for all eternity, or at least as long as the cave stands.  Death has
not improved his particularly nasty disposition, and he is likely to
attack any and all who venture near him.

Mobs.Name: ghost lost newbie
Mobs.LongDescription: "Have you seen my corpse?" asks the ghost of the lost newbie.
Mobs.Description:
Wandering lost and bewildered, this poor adventurer never had a chance.
He stumbled into a mature dragon when he was yet an infant in
experience and alas, never found his corpse.  He is doomed to roam
forevermore in these caves beneath the monastery.

Mobs.Name: phantom
Mobs.LongDescription: The Phantom of the Cavern's music weaves spells of great evil.
Mobs.Description:
His dragon face mostly covered by a white plaster mask, the evil
Phantom of the Cavern was once a lowly bard who wandered into these
caves in search of the perfect set of stalactites with which to create
a great cave organ.  Burned into insanity as a result of a brush with
the crematorium, he has haunted these dark caves ever since.  He
enchants with his music, but 'tis an evil enchantment.

Mobs.Name: skeleton dragon hero
Mobs.LongDescription: The massive skeleton of an undead dragon hero moves slowly towards you.
Mobs.Description:
The greatest of all the old time dragon heroes, this dragon died over a
thousand years ago.  Does any body this massive ever completely die?
Evidently this one has not, for it has been wandering the dragon caves
for a millenium.

Mobs.Name: teleporting mage ghost
Mobs.LongDescription: The ghostly mage screams, "CAST 'TELEPORT' ME!!!"
Mobs.Description:
Alas, this would-be great wizard teleported herself right into a nest
of playful dragons.  They thought she would make a great toy and were
very disappointed when she didn't last for very long.  She has her
revenge, however.  She will be haunting these caves as long as they are
here.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 moan

Mobs.Name: Daffodil daffy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Daffy flaps her infant wings as hard as she can, creating a sandstorm.
Mobs.Description:
Born a soft creamy yellow, Daffodil's color has deepened to the yellow
of spring daffodils.  Nicknamed Daffy for the silly things she does,
Daffy is still a favorite in the nursery.  Except, of course, when she
whips up a strong wind with her wings!

Mobs.Name: dragon fourth forth 4th consort
Mobs.LongDescription: "Wanna PK?", yawns the dragon.
Mobs.Description:
A virtual dragon database of information about the latest in armor and
dragon enemies, this old guy knows it all.  Let him tell you about his
masterful defeat of the master ranger, or the time he made the elf king
flee.  For all his knowledge and for all his toys, the old coot has a
strong aura of boredom surrounding him.

Mobs.Name: dragon consort
Mobs.LongDescription: The queen's consort idly shoots darts into a picture of the elf king.
Mobs.Description:
The post sounded ideal, of course.  All this powerful knightly dragon
had to do was kick back and look studly. His official duty is to
protect the queen and provide adult supervision to the hatchlings, but
in reality he spends his days gossiping with the other consorts while
the hatchlings play wild games.

Mobs.Name: dragon master dm MrTeacher
Mobs.LongDescription: #RThe Dragon Master tells you, "Interruptions are not allowed!"#N
Mobs.Description:
The Dragon Master is attempting to teach the young dragons the
rudimentary skills of dragonhood, that is, breathing fire, devastating
villages, eating elves, and so forth.  He does not appreciate
interruptions to his classes.  He is a short-tempered dragon who would
rather be flying about the forest with his brethren.

Mobs.Name: dragon queen smd sexy mud
Mobs.LongDescription:
The sexy mud dragon looks you over from under very thick (and very
fake) lashes, wondering whether you are worth the bother of killing.
Mobs.Description:
From the tip of her very beautiful (to a dragon) long tail to the end
of her toothy smile, the DraGoN QuEeN is the image of female dragon
beauty.  You may suspect that the tail has been artificially enhanced,
that the teeth have been whitened and sharpened by one of the dragon
mages, but the effect is nevertheless overpowering.  Male dragons are
instantly hit with an uncontrollable desire to take her places and give
her expensive toys.  One gift clearly was the lovely id bracelet she
wears on one dainty dragon ankle.

Mobs.Name: studly dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The very studly dragon struts around the cave, flexing his muscles.
Mobs.Description:
The young dragon is very pleased with himself and his appearance.
Certain that he has the shiniest and newest of dragon armor, that his
muscles are the bulgiest, his teeth the pointiest, his spells the
scariest and his breath the nastiest, his arrogance is matchless.  He
is certain that of all the Queen's consorts, he is her secret heart's
desire.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 flex;%2 emote admires himself in the mirror.;%3 emote flexes his  
mighty biceps, showing off his sexy mud dragon tattoo.

Mobs.Name: elf slave cook chef
Mobs.LongDescription: Slaving away over a hot stove, the elven chef curses fate.
Mobs.Description:
Chosen more by accident than for her extraordinary ability to make
delicious meals from unusual ingredients, the elven chef is a true
artist in the kitchen.  Tall and strong, she bullies the weaker dragons
into fetching the ingredients that she needs from the surface world.
Unfortunately for her, she is guarded by some of the stronger dragons.
The DraGoN QueEn gets quite grumpy when she doesn't eat regularly.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 wetfish;%2 taunt dragon;%2 wrestle;%2 headache

Mobs.Name: Froggy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Froggy hops over to you, long dragon tongue shooting out to sample you.
Mobs.Description:
Froggy was born a deep green frog color!  When Moonshine is mad at her,
she calls her Toad.  The dragons are rarely mad at Froggy, though.  She
hops happily around the caves going "Ribbit! Ribbit!" and pretending to
be a frog.  You will notice the absence of flies in the cave ...
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 hop

Mobs.Name: gentle dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The tall dragon towers over you before gently flame-broiling you.
Mobs.Description:
In truth, a dragon can be quite gentle when he is as powerful as this
one.  Due to his size he must unfortunately eat quite often, but he
tries very hard not to scare his dinner too badly.  It's bad for the
digestion, of course, to eat something that was frightened to death.

Mobs.Name: grumbly dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Grumbly glares, her eyebrowns drawn together in a perpetual frown.
Mobs.Description:
"You'll never lure a nice meal to you if you are always in a bad mood,
Grumbly,", the DraGoN QueEn admonishes Grumbly.  But it is in her
nature to be unhappy with the world as it is, and to share her
displeasure with her fellow dragons.  As a result, they tend to avoid
her and she has that much more to grumble about.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote mutters softly under her breath about idiot adventurers.;%2
emote grumbles unintelligibly to herself.;%1 emote grumbles, "Sunshine 
is entirely too sunny, and Moonshine is entirely too full of himself."

Mobs.Name: HotShot dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: HotShot shoots a small but very hot tongue of flame towards you!
Mobs.Description:
Some dragons are just born talented.  HotShot made the old Dragon Queen
cry with joy when she hatched.  HotShot blasted her way out of her
shell with tiny shots of white-hot flame.  Her flame red color
contrasts sharply with the soft pastels of her siblings and cousins
here in the nursery.  The dragons have great hopes for her future even
though she is as yet quite small.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 gloat;%5 boast

Mobs.Name: jackrabbit
Mobs.LongDescription: The jackrabbit bounds rapidly away from you on long strong rabbit legs.
Mobs.Description:
Measured from the tips of his very long upstanding ears to the tips of
his very long feet, the jackrabbit would be near the height of that
gnome who's been pacing through the woods.  But it is unlikely the
jackrabbit will allow you close enough to measure him!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 hop;%2 jump;%3 emote twitches his nose and whiskers.

Mobs.Name: Dood dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Dood flexes his mighty tail and blows some mighty fire.
Mobs.Description:
Dood dreams of days when he will fly with his mighty wings high above
Tynstri, terrorizing the villagers, the monks and even the fish in the
lake.  He will be the Ultimate dragon and elves will quake at the sound
of his name!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say excellent!;%1 say Yo! doods and doodettes!;%1 say like totally, 
man!; %1 say I love you man!; %1 embrace dragon; %1 say as if!; %1 say 
Duh! my bad!; %2 say so that's how you get your jollies! picking on 
poor little baby dragons!

Mobs.Name: KaBoom! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: "KaBoom!  KaBoom!", says the little dragon, as he detonates his toy.
Mobs.Description:
KaBoom! got his nickname when some dwarven miners mistakenly thought
that this particular cavern might make a good place to explore.  One of
the adult dragons detonated them, and then there were no more miners.
KaBoom! was very excited about the explosions and has been running
around practicing that spell ever since.  Fortunately for you, he is
still a little young to have perfected it.

Mobs.Name: Mole dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Soft and quiet, Mole sneaks up behind you and steals your weapons.
Mobs.Description:
Stealth isn't normal for dragons.  Not at all.  Not a bit!  But with
Mole it's second nature.  He is dark for a dragon - a deep brown gray
that blends with unpainted cavern walls.  He moves quietly, learning to
steal what other dragons take by force.

Mobs.Name: Moonshine dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A dragon the color of moonshine eyes you with a calculating sparkle.
Mobs.Description:
Moonshine's adventures easily eclipse those of his twin sister,
Sunshine.  He is by far the more courageous of the pair and is liable
to be found anywhere in the great underground series of caves, even
(when he escapes from the Dragon Master) along the great Trail of the
Undead  Dragons.

Mobs.Name: Oopsi dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Oopsi casually stumbles over nothing and comes crashing into you! OUCH!
Mobs.Description:
To say she is a little clumsy would be an understatement.  Oopsi's
problem isn't just that her feet are way too large for the rest of her
body, it's the whole coordination thing.  Still, she is a dragon and
should find someone like, say, you, easy enough to manage.

Mobs.Name: PinKy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Midget dragon PinKy looks anxiously for a place to hide.
Mobs.Description:
A tiny pink dragon, PinKy has always been a little self-concious
because of her size.  The older dragons tell her that magic does not
require great strength, but she is still frightened of much of her
world.  The elders despair of her ever being ready to leave the
cavenest.

Mobs.Name: Splat! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Splat! you go as Splat! hops up and down on top of you.
Mobs.Description:
Splat! is a VERY hefty dragon who has yet to learn proper rules of
dragon decorum.  Her favorite attack is to jump wildly up and down on
top of her victim.  Due to her size and lack of serious prey in the
dragon caves, this is actually quite effective!

Mobs.Name: Puff dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Puff! casually blows a cloud of smoke your way.
Mobs.Description:
Puff! has got this smoke blowing thing down very well!  He can blow
rings and squares and small clouds at will.  The other young dragons,
who are in truth a bit jealous, say it's because he gets all the
choicest bits of adventurer to eat.

Mobs.Name: ScreaMEr dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: ScreaMEr lets out a string of dragon obscenities.
Mobs.Description:
A bit spoiled, ScreaMEr tends to throw wild tantrums when she doesn't
get her own way.  Sometimes she just stomps off screaming, "I'll never
play with you again.  I HATE you!" and sometimes she attacks, claws
flying.

Mobs.Name: SmoKy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: SmoKy sees you and quickly disappears behind a cloud of smoke.
Mobs.Description:
This beautifully pale gray dragon finds it easy to hide in a cloud of
smoke, and at her age she is pretty good at creating the smoke.  SmoKy
is a bit shy, but she is looking forward to heading out of the caves
and into the forest soon.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 cast 'invisibility' SmoKy;%5 smoke;%5 pose;%5 crack;%10 vis

Mobs.Name: Sneaker dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Sneaker sits down to enjoy the cookies he "found" in Puff's hidey-hole.
Mobs.Description:
Sneaker is, unfortunately, a little sneak.  A very clever little sneak,
at that!  He is quite good at discovering where his cousins have hidden
their treasures, then "borrowing" the treasures.  Dragons being not
known for their stealth (they are simply much too LARGE to move all
that quietly), Sneaker's father has had some serious questions for the
DraGoN QueEn about Sneaker's possible parentage.

Mobs.Name: Sunshine dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A bright yellow dragon glows at you, making you feel warm all over.
Mobs.Description:
Sunshine is a sunny bright yellow dragon named not for her color or
shine but for her disposition.  She and her twin, Moonshine, are the
newest arrivals at the dragon breeding grounds in the great cavern
under the monastery.

Mobs.Name: Swipe dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Swipe stumbles by you and suddenly you are missing your backpack!
Mobs.Description:
Swipe is in training to be the master thief.  Dragons do not usually
have the dexterity needed to excel at this profession, but Swipe has
developed the nimble fingers of an elf and a clever mind to use them.

Mobs.Name: tarantula spider
Mobs.LongDescription: With eight long furry legs, the tarantula skitters rapidly toward you.
Mobs.Description:
Gold and brown are the colors of this rather beautiful spider.
Beautiful but deadly, that is.  The body at the center of the eight
long hairy legs is about the width of a human male's hand.  The legs
are each about twice that size.  The tarantula is able to move rapidly
and is not likely to attack you except in defense.

Mobs.Name: Tweaker dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Tweaker floats towards you, eyes twirling independently of each other.
Mobs.Description:
Tweaker's soft minty green has an occasional yellowish cast due to some
of the strange magical concoctions he quaffs.  This clutch of dragons
was so numerous that some of the quieter hatchlings seem to fade into
the cave walls, as if rendered invisible by their lack of importance.
Tweaker's answer to this has been to lose himself in magic.  He does
lose the feeling of invisibility with this indulgence.

Mobs.Name: violet dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The soft pale purple dragon smells of violets and springtime.
Mobs.Description:
Clearly a child of the ferocious great purple dragon who terrorizes the
skies of this elven homeland, Violet has inherited his great heart as
well as his lovely color.  The dragon master has had a difficult time
with her, however, as she would much rather be picking (and munching)
flowers than learning to burn.

Mobs.Name: Wa-Z dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Wa-Z is weakening the cavern walls with her wild wailing.
Mobs.Description:
Not a quiet infant, Wa-Z lets the world know when she is not happy.
She is not happy at the moment, and the strength of her cries is
actually weakening the magic that keeps the cavern lit.  The cries
resonate so loudly that the cavern rock is developping large cracks.

Mobs.Name: Whodeeny dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Whodeeny trips about the cave looking for rabbits to pull from his hat.
Mobs.Description:
Unfortunately for Whodeeny (the Mystical Mage to be!), all the rabbits
which might be available to live in his hat have been made into rabbit
stew by the elf cooks.  He had a stuffed rabbit when he was a little
younger, but HotShot burnt it to a crisp a year ago.  It was a vile act
of revenge.  Whodeeny hadn't really meant to make HotShot's tail turn
pink.  It just happened.

Mobs.Name: Whoosh! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: With one mighty swoop of her wings, Whoosh! knocks you off your feet.
Mobs.Description:
"Wings as Weapons" was this studious dragons favorite reading in dragon
school.  She stole the dragon master's sole copy of the manual and
studied it every night, sneaking over to the catacombs to practice
flying.  The zombies weren't too happy at being knocked over all the
time, but Whoosh! thought it was great fun.

Mobs.Name: Wuuda dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Wuuda looks at you curiously, wondering if she is allowed to eat you.
Mobs.Description:
Wuuda is a powerful and rapidly growing young gray dragon.  She has
specialized in martial arts and is proud of the rapidly hardening
muscles in her legs and wings.  She will soon be leaving the cave to
terrorize the forest above.

Mobs.Name: fighter dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: "And I'll huff and I'll puff and I'll ...", boasts the young dragon.
Mobs.Description:
A dragon in training is an awesome sight.  It takes a lot of practice
to get the right amount of heat into your breath and to get the flame
just the right length to do the most damage.  Then there are the "how
to take care of your claws" practices and flying practice and "Wing
Care" and spells.  For most young dragons it gets to be, well, a DRAG!
but this little guy takes it quite seriously and works hard at being
the best.

Mobs.Name: ghost adventurer greedy
Mobs.LongDescription: The greedy adventurer's ghost searches forevermore for the treasure.
Mobs.Description:
An adventurer who went one step too far in her search for treasure.
'nuff said.

Mobs.Name: gateguard elf guard cityguard m6600
Mobs.LongDescription: The Tynstri guard in his dazzling white uniform stands at attention.
Mobs.Description:
The gateguards are chosen for their immense good looks as well as their
strength and nobility of character.  Their ears come to a beautiful
point on each side of their heads.  They are dressed in immaculate
white uniforms decorated with gold braid at the shoulders and shiny
gold buttons down the front.  Although apparently at their post for
show, the guards are very capable of defending their fair city.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%3 emote snaps his heels together and salutes you smartly.;%3 emote  
stares stonily straight ahead, looking intent.;%1 boast;%2 flex;%2
strut

Mobs.Name: watcher elf guard m6601
Mobs.LongDescription: The watcher is an elf of exceptionally keen vision and powerful lungs.
Mobs.Description:
The short, keen-eyed elf has chosen to spend his days and nights
watching over the kingdom.  Many dangers threaten a kingdom of
forest-dwellers, not the least of which is fire.  Recently, too, the
kingdom has faced a plague of dragons, reputedly the worst in a
millenia.  Gnomish scientists report they are growing deep in the
bowels of the earth, and occasionally the dragons and their kin may be
seen flying low over the green forests of Tynstri.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote stares moodily out at the forest.;%5 smile ;%5 emote 
mutters, "These young elves know nothing about fighting dragons!"

Mobs.Name: watcher elf guard
Mobs.LongDescription: The watcher stands his lonely vigil, alert to danger.
Mobs.Description:
The watcher spends his days and nights watching the road leading to
Tynstri, watching for danger.  At 983 years old, he is past his
fighting prime, but still eager to defend his homeland.  The watcher 
retains the keen vision of his youth, and is ready to alert the 
villagers of any threat.  He is still strong and stands tall and 
proud.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 Hey! You! What are you doing up here?;%5 Bah! Young elves have no 
idea of the dangers the dragons bring!;%5 emote looks directly into 
your eyes, then grabs the big horn and sounds a warning!

Mobs.Name: mother vulture
Mobs.LongDescription: The mother vulture glares at you angrily, protecting her nest.
Mobs.Description:
Vultures are very enormous birds and this one is no exception.  Shiny
black feathers cover her huge wingspan, and her eyes glow with a
fiercely protective maternal light.  Her strong talons and sharply
hooked beak are usually used to rip small animals into tiny pieces to
feed her nestlings, but she would take on a larger animal (you!) if
need be.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote preens, carefully cleaning each feather with her beak.

Mobs.Name: Lisette bartender elf shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The dainty bartending elf looks up and greets you by name.
Mobs.Description:
Lisette looks almost too good to be true.  Her chestnut hair tumbles
thickly down her back to her waist, and her eyes twinkle cheerfully at
you from an expressive elven face.  She is a tiny, dainty elf and
appears too fragile to manage the rowdy crowd in this bar.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote carefully wipes down the bar with an old rag.;%5 chuckle;%5 
bkiss bouncer

Mobs.Name: bouncer elf
Mobs.LongDescription:
The bouncer looks strong enough to handle a whole band of drunken
ogres.
Mobs.Description:
The bouncer looks almost too muscle bound to be an elf.  At two meters
(6'6") he has the height, but his broad chest and shoulders and
muscular thighs tell you he has relatives from one of the other, more
"meaty" races of this world.  Whatever his origin, he adores Lisette
and allows no roughness in her bar.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 wink lisette;%5 emote looks around the room, watching out for 
trouble.;%1 glare;%2 flex;%2 growl

Mobs.Name: lizardman drinker
Mobs.LongDescription: The lizardman is quietly drinking in a corner, ogling the bartender.
Mobs.Description:
The lizardman comes here occasionally to have a drink and watch people
come and go.  He is tall, with a longish tail that tends to whip back
and forth when he is upset.  His leathery skin looks very thick, which
could be why he is ignoring the glaring looks he gets from the
bouncers.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 stare lisette;%1 emote slyly ogles Lisette through half closed 
lids.;%1 stare lisette; %1 drool Jemara

Mobs.Name: fairy Jemara
Mobs.LongDescription: Jemara the Fairy Warrior sits at the bar, staring moodily at drink.
Mobs.Description:
Jemara has been friends with Lisette for years, and is a frequent
visitor at the bar.  A bit flighty, she's had trouble settling down
with just one fairy.  She comes to Lisette to pour out her heart.
Jemara has bright red hair that flows in thick waves down to her tiny
waist.  She has quick, delicate movements, and seems to be in constant
motion.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote tosses her curls back over her shoulder.;%2 flirt bouncer;%5 
wiggle;%7 wink bouncer

Mobs.Name: Gamarr
Mobs.LongDescription: Gamarr the half-elf carefully evaluates his cards, his face blank.
Mobs.Description:
Gamarr is an infrequent visitor to the bar, but he is always up for a
hand of poker with the other "boys" in the back room.   He wins more
often than he loses.  Gamarr is tall, athletic and smooth.  He has an
easy kind of charm that his fellow poker players trust.  Gamarr is the
source of the elven girlie posters lining the walls, which tend to
distract his opponents from their losses.  Gemarr is a cautious cheat.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%2 emote folds his cards into a neat stack and places them facedown on 
the table.;%5 smoke

Mobs.Name: rowland half-elf
Mobs.LongDescription: Rowland the half elf rocks back in his chair and leers at the pinups.
Mobs.Description:
Rowland is a regular at the bar and in the backroom.  He whines loudly
about being misunderstood at home, but is generally ignored here.
Rowland is very large, very fat and very sloppy.  He spends a lot of
money on beer at the bar, but he usually manages to spill at least one
drink, and frequently causes fights.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 snort; %5 whine

Mobs.Name: poker player gambler
Mobs.LongDescription: The gambler throws down his cards in disgust.
Mobs.Description:
The gambler has been coming here Saturday nights for years for a
friendly game of cards.  He enjoys the mead that Lisette keeps flowing
and the companionship of his buddies, to say nothing of the elven
girlie pictures decorating the walls.  He never wins much, but he never
loses much either.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 insult player;%2 stare

Mobs.Name: Rictus
Mobs.LongDescription: Rictus grins at you with a smile so wide it would shame a shark.
Mobs.Description:
Hair slicked carefully back and shoes polished to a mirror shine,
Rictus is a very carefully dressed elf.  He has the widest smile you
have ever seen, and his teeth gleam whitely in the light.  You sense
somehow, in spite of the wide smile and well dressed air, that there is
a deep core of evil inside him.  When you see the unwinking eye in the
medallion at his neck, your worst fears are confirmed.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile;%2 grin;%1 smirk

Mobs.Name: recruit elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The eager recruit trains for the day he will be able to free the elves.
Mobs.Description:
The Free the Elves movement has its headquarters right in Tynstri,
where
they recruit and train strong elves to infiltrate the assassin hideaway
where their brethren have been imprisoned.  The path is hard to
victory, but their cause is just!  This elf is quite young, but strong
and fierce in his determination to prevail.

Mobs.Name: radical elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The wild-eyed radical elf rescues elf slaves from all over the world.
Mobs.Description:
He cares for nothing except his cause, saving the kidnapped elves.
Bands of assassin marauders have been seen in the forest near Tynstri.
They capture unwary elves and sell them as slaves to the drow or keep
them to cook in their kitchens.  The radical elf has dedicated his life
to rescuing these poor unfortunates.  His hair is in a wild golden halo
around his head and his eyes have the look of a fanatic, which he is.
If you are not there to help him in his cause, then get out of his way.

Mobs.Name: Rose shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Rose knows she has a good nose for a bargain.
Mobs.Description:
Rose prefers to think of her merchandise as "previously owned", and of
herself as caring for Mother Nature by recycling clothing and armor no
longer needed by the people who come to her shop.  A sharp-eyed elf of
middle years, Rose will make alterations on the spot so that anything
you buy will fit you.

Mobs.Name: Flora shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Flora hurries up to you, wide white apron around her ample waist.
Mobs.Description:
Flora's long blond hair has slowly turned white over the years, and her
soft clear skin has become as full of small wrinkles and lines as an
old apple.  She has run the Flowers & Sweets shop here for long years.
She enjoys helping people choose gifts, and she is able to keep an eye
on her philandering elf, Seymour, from here.

Mobs.Name: Elmer shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The dusty old elf peers at you over his glasses.
Mobs.Description:
Elmer wanted to call his store "Elmer's Treasures" because that is what
he thinks of each strange little item he sells here.  He delights in
things - useful or no - which cannot be readily found anywhere else.
Elmer is something of a one-of-a-kind himself!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote mutters abruptly, "Yes, yes, well, now WHAT was it you
wanted?"

Mobs.Name: Seymour shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Seymour looks at you nervously through his badly splotched glasses.
Mobs.Description:
Seymour waits on his customers with badly shaking hands.  He is an elf
of middle years, and lives a quiet life.  Caring for his plants and
mixing concoctions have become the main focus of his life.  His blond
hair has become liberally mixed with gray, and his elven slenderness is
marred by a slight paunch around his middle.  Too many visits to his
wife's sweets shop?  Perhaps.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 say Would you like to visit my special plant in the back room?

Mobs.Name: Audrey assistant
Mobs.LongDescription: Audrey bats her baby blue eyes at you and gives you a toothy grin.
Mobs.Description:
Audrey is very well cared for.  She never has a bad hair day.  Every
blond hair is perfectly groomed.  Her fingernails are quite long,
perfectly shaped and a different shade every day.  She wears frilly
pink and white dresses to work.  You wonder what her function is at
Seymour's greenhouse.

Mobs.Name: AudreyII plant
Mobs.LongDescription:
The voracious, man-eating plant Audrey II, winks slyly at you and says,
"C'mere cutie!"
Mobs.Description:
AudreyII is the special pet of Seymour, although Seymour sometimes
wonders who's the pet and who is the owner.  AudreyII grew from a tiny
bulb which was a present from Brother Russ from the wiccan monastery on
the hill.  She grew rapidly into the massive size you see now, filling
entirely one corner of the room, her vine-like branches reaching out
towards you.   "Aw, c'mon", AudreyII says entreatingly, "Come closer
and give me a tickle!".  AudreyII leers at you, and there's a look on
the blossom of the plant that somehow reminds you of a cat, watching
and waiting for a mouse to fall into its clutches.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote says in her deep baritone voice, #y"Mmm ... hmmm !! You look 
good enough to eat!"#N;%2 emote ogles you, leering.;%2 drool;%2 wink;%2 
beckons to you, curling a leaf at you.;%2 say Is that a pistil in your 
pocket or are you just happy to see me?;%3 emote slyly wraps a vine 
around your waist and tugs you closer.

Mobs.Name: myconoid mushroom
Mobs.LongDescription: The myconoid mushroom dislikes you on sight!
Mobs.Description:
The mushroom is a bit cranky.  He is only happy in the dark damp closed
in world he normally inhabits.  Sunlight and fresh air make him feel
sick.  Seymour planted a few myconoids as an experiment many years ago,
but he unfortunately forgot about them.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%05 say The light! The light! Get rid of that light, you monster!

Mobs.Name: Roland singer entertainer
Mobs.LongDescription: Roland the roving bard sings epic tales of heroes of old.
Mobs.Description:
A small elf of advancing years, Roland spent many years on the road,
wandering from place to place, making a living by bringing news of
lands far away in his song.  He sang of the glorious deeds of heroes of
old and of heroes of today.  As age began to dim his sight and hearing,
he came home to retire.  He works at Barns & Nibble as a favor to his
cousin, bringing in more customers with his entertainment.

Mobs.Name: waiter shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The waiter is patiently waiting for your order.
Mobs.Description:
Harry is working at Barns & Nibble while he is still a student, which
he fears will be forever.  He likes the easy pace here.  People come in
and sit and read books from the shelves, sip the cafe's special teas
and chat with friends.  Harry dislikes the owner's cats, which always
seem to trip him up, and he can't understand why they are allowed in
here.

Mobs.Name: cluecat cat
Mobs.LongDescription: Cluecat's whiskers twitch as he watches you.
Mobs.Description:
Cluecat's a very funny looking cat, with his tail ending in a strange
little curve.  He is a orange tabby cat, big and fluffy.  He is very
curious as well, even for a cat, and he has already used 8 of his 9
lives as a result!  Cluecat's funny hooked tail looks just like a
question mark.

Mobs.Name: bluecat cat
Mobs.LongDescription: Bluecat follows Roland around when he is singing blues.
Mobs.Description:
Bluecat is indeed a kind of smoky gray-blue, but he was named not for
his color but for his love of blues music.  Ever since Roland has been
singing at Barns & Nibble, Bluecat has been his disciple.  He twines in
and out of Roland's legs as he walks.  He yowls when Roland sings
something other than blues.    He purrs loudly and drools when Roland
does sing blues.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 purr;%5 emote rubs himself against your legs.;
%5 em howls to the music.

Mobs.Name: Stewcat cat
Mobs.LongDescription: Stewcat casually eyes you as you receive your food, ready grab a bite.
Mobs.Description:
Although he is enormously fat, Stewcat seems always to be hungry.  He
loves being at Barns & Nibble because he loves the food here, and
appreciates all the fine elves who come in and buy some and eat it
here.  If they aren't wary, he manages to steal some.  Very clever at
sizing elves up, he manages to look pitiful enough that many patrons
give him their food voluntarily.  And, of course, there are always the
leftover crumbs people leave behind.  He is especially partial to fish
& chips, and hopes you will remember that when you come back.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote whines pitifully, trying to look hungry.

Mobs.Name: saleself shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription:
#cThe saleself whispers to you, "Hey, baby, how's your #rlove
life#c?."#N
Mobs.Description:
Although perfectly clean, there is something unwholesome about this
elf.  Perhaps it is just the loud pink, bright orange, pea green and
saffron of his overtunic.  Perhaps it is the strong smell of mint on
his breath.   Or perhaps the arch look in his eyes as he seems to size
you up.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Say list, baby, see all I got to offer!

Mobs.Name: horatio weaponsmith shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Horatio sharpens the weapons and recounts stories of his days of glory.
Mobs.Description:
Horatio turned in his uniform when he married, and completed training
as a weaponsmith.  He remembers how important it was to have a sharp,
properly tempered weapon.  Being elven, he also recognizes the
importance of magic in the weapons he sells.  Horatio's muscles bulge
beneath his thin cotton tunic.  A red cotton headband keeps the sweat
from his eyes.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 flex

Mobs.Name: bunny punk
Mobs.LongDescription: The orange and magenta bunny wiggles his long, earring-bedecked ear.
Mobs.Description:
"Whoa! Baby!" you think as you see the cute little bunny with the
wildly-dyed fur.  Was this some kind of Easter prank or what?  Then you
notice the row of tiny earrings piercing one long ear and the strange
rhythm to his hop and you know you've just met your first funky punk
bunny.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%2 hop;%2 emote twitches one ear;%5 say Move it or lose it, baby;%5 
say Hey, what's hoppening, baby?

Mobs.Name: pickpocket elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The pickpocket's hand slides deftly into your pocket.
Mobs.Description:
A slim young woman, dressed casually but neatly in a long tunic with
many pockets.  Her hair is more of a golden brown than the usual blond
of elves.  At first she appears very clumsy, as you notice she seems to
collide with a large number of shoppers.  Then you notice that when she
does, her hand dips quickly into a pocket, bag or backpack of her
victim, and that even as she is profusely apologizing she is dropping
something she has filched into one of her own many pockets.

Mobs.Name: pickpocket elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The gray-clad elf blends in with the shadows where he strolls.
Mobs.Description:
The elf lost everything in a sudden blast of fire from a large purple
dragon.  His family home of the past 500 years was turned to cinders.
Down hearted, down trodden and destitute, he has taken to a life of
crime not so much for the paltry amounts he is able to filch from
passers by, but for the exultant feeling of control.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote looks at you craftily.

Mobs.Name: bunny vampire
Mobs.LongDescription: The adorable little bunny snarls at you, revealing long, pointy fangs.
Mobs.Description:
"What a cute little cotton-tailed piece of fluff!" you think ... The
little white bunny is right out of a child's storybook ... until he
