snarls and you see the long pointed fangs of a vampire bunny!  More
like a nightmare!  Get out the garlic!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%3 hop;%2 snarl

Mobs.Name: assassin
Mobs.LongDescription: The assassin is kidnapping elves to be Gontran's kitchen slaves.
Mobs.Description:
Covered head to toe in a midnight-black cloak, it is impossible to
determine any of the features of this assassin.   His movements are
furtive as he slips quietly from cover to cover waiting for someone to
walk through these woods alone.

Mobs.Name: drow
Mobs.LongDescription: The drow is looking for elves to enslave.
Mobs.Description:
Born to the dark path, well-trained in fighting, in magic, and in
cruelty, the drow travel in darkness to find and enslave others.  Some
are sold, some are eaten and some are forced to work - perhaps as
targets - back in the dark drow caves.  Being strong and long of life,
the elves are much sought after as slaves.

Mobs.Name: vine thorn thorny
Mobs.LongDescription: The long, thick vine attempts to wrap itself around you.
Mobs.Description:
The vine is about as thick as your little finger, with thorns as long
as your thumbnail, and much much sharper.  It wraps itself around your
arms, legs and neck as you push your way along the trail, as if it
would prefer to keep you captive.  Local elves call this the "nightmare
vine" because it is so hard to escape.

Mobs.Name: dryad nymph
Mobs.LongDescription: The beautiful dryad dances nimbly, enchanting you with her grace.
Mobs.Description:
The dryad appears to float gracefully above the ground in her dance.  A
young female elf, she has chosen to "bond" with the trees, and she and
her companions spend their days caring for their clearing, planting it
with magic.  As she dances, she sings, and the combined songs of all of
the dryads in this clearing is so lovely that even the trees stop
growing to listen.

Mobs.Name: unicorn
Mobs.LongDescription: The snowy white unicorn rests proudly beneath the huge tree.
Mobs.Description:
The unicorn is a solitary, magical creature, enchanted with the magic
of the maidens of the forest.  In size and form, he strongly resembles
a noble white stallion, with the exception of the long golden horn
sprouting from his forehead.   He is a very shy, wary creature and
rarely seen by mortals such as you.

Mobs.Name: pookah
Mobs.LongDescription: This old nag looks like a safe and easy ride - if a bit slow.
Mobs.Description:
The pookah loves to trick unwary travellers looking for an easy ride to
get them off their feet.  He is a shape-changer, and can look like
whatever he wants, but most often he will pretend to be a tired old
horse.  When a tired old elf climbs on, he takes off quickly and gives
them a merry, scary ride.

Mobs.Name: pixie
Mobs.LongDescription: The pixie laughs at you, unseen, as he *pokes* and *tickles* you.
Mobs.Description:
A tiny, distant relative of the elves, the pixies are like small
children in their love of mischief.   The pixie loves to take you by
surprise.  Some of the elder elves in Tynstri wanted to force the
pixies
to wear bells on their toes so there would be some warning before the
pixies got up to their tricks, but the pixies just laughed and said,
"Gotta catch us first!"
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 snicker;%2 cackle;%1 giggle;%3 smirk

Mobs.Name: tree
Mobs.LongDescription:
The blossom-laden tree is filled with the spirit of Mother Earth
herself.
Mobs.Description:
Tree or female spirit?  The tree towers over all of the other trees in
the glade.  The branches are thick and strong, with many small branches
leading off each larger one.  The tree is covered with dark green
leaves, large and soft, and large pink and white blossoms.  The
fragrance from the blossoms is sweet, enticing.  The tree's bark is a
deep brown, with deep vertical wavy ridges.  Touching the tree fills
you with a sense of peace.

Mobs.Name: mudsucker fish
Mobs.LongDescription: This mudsucker swallows easy prey along the bottom of the lake.
Mobs.Description:
The mudsucker is a sandy shade of brown, perfect for blending into her
surroundings.  A long, rounded fish with strangely glowing golden eyes,
the mudsucker moves slowly and as little as possible preferring instead
to wait for her prey to swim close to her.  She opens her mouth as you
swim by, perhaps hoping you will simply swim in?
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote opens her many-toothed mouth wide, waiting for you to swim 
into her maw.

Mobs.Name: bullywug
Mobs.LongDescription: The bullywug's bulging golden eyes focus suddenly on you!
Mobs.Description:
The bullywug reminds you of a frog, except you've never seen a frog
quite this big!  His skin is greenish - like a frog, and smooth except
for the occasional wart.  His hind legs are long and strong and
powerful.  His face gives no clue  to his thoughts - if indeed he has
any.  Suddenly his huge rim of a mouth opens and a long, pink,
snakelike tongue whips out and pulls an enormous insect into his maw.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%05 say Ribbit!;%05 emote whips another insect into her mouth with her 
long pink tongue.

Mobs.Name: stickleback
Mobs.LongDescription: The stickleback will defend his nest to the death (yours).
Mobs.Description:
This stickleback is not a huge fish, but what he lacks in size he makes
up for in determination and intensity ... that and natural defenses.
His back is covered with sharp thorny spines that look like they might
hurt if you got too close.  His belly is a beautiful bright red, so you
know he's guarding his nest.  Sticklebacks are known to fight fish
several times their size - and win.  You hope he realizes that you are
NOT a fish and NO threat to his babies!

Mobs.Name: mudskipper
Mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Mudskipper skips toward you, mouth open to take a big bite!
Mobs.Description:
The mudskipper looks a little like a long, thick snake with tentacles.
Comfortable in or out of water, he will merrily chase you wherever you
go.  His grey/green color blends in well with the weeds at the bottom
of this enormous lake, so watch out for him!

Mobs.Name: lamprey eel
Mobs.LongDescription: The lamprey eel attaches itself to you like an extra arm.
Mobs.Description:
The lamprey looks like a long thick tube.  This one is about 40" long
(100cm).  It has a large round mouth lined with sharp thorny teeth that
it would like to use to attach itself to you.  "It is so much nicer if
your food provides you with locomotion and all you have to do is hang
on and suck", it thinks.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote sucks out all your life juices as it eats your flesh.

Mobs.Name: bass fish
Mobs.LongDescription: The large, wide-mouthed bass works his jaw up and down slowly.
Mobs.Description:
The silver green bass swims in and out of the shadows, silently opening
and shutting its very large mouth, looking hungrily at you.  The bass
is covered in thick green and silver scales, and he propels himself
through the water by means of his powerful fins and his long, muscular
body.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote practices to take his first bite out of you.

Mobs.Name: catfish fish
Mobs.LongDescription: The catfish stares at you, unblinking, twirling his long wispy feelers.
Mobs.Description:
The deep blue-green of this catfish tends to make him blend into the
deep blue-green of the lake.  The long, trailing feelers on each side
of his mouth give him the appearance of a wise, old elf, however he is
neither wise nor old, but he IS hungry ...

Mobs.Name: carp fish
Mobs.LongDescription: The ancient carp is gobbling up everything in its path.
Mobs.Description:
This old carp has been living on the bottom of the lake for over a
century eating plants, insects, other fish and adventurers who look
like fish.  He has a blunt nose and a small, thick-lipped mouth, with 2
pairs of feelers dangling from his upper lip.   He has a wide, heavy
body covered with large scales.  He is olive green on back and his
sides are a dusky gold, his belly a bright yellow.

Mobs.Name: fiddler crab
Mobs.LongDescription: The fiddler crab plays a jaunty tune on his fiddle, luring you closer.
Mobs.Description:
The fiddler crab has two long sharp claws that he manipulates with
amazing dexterity.  He plays happy songs on his fiddle, hoping you will
be distracted by the music and dance right into his claws.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote breaks in to a wild song on his fiddle.

Mobs.Name: novice monk
Mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk shops for the wiccan monastery on the hill.
Mobs.Description:
Dressed in a long, dark green woolen robe tied at the waist with a
braided belt, the novice wanders from shop to shop looking for items
needed by his brothers at the monastery.  He is an elf of medium
height, his long blond hair tied back with a thong made from braided
grasses.  His deep blue eyes look out at you with intelligence.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em peers about uncertainly.

Mobs.Name: lake elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The lake elf glides deftly through the water, rooting out evil.
Mobs.Description:
He patrols this lake, protecting it from evil influences.  His
silver-blue hair floats about his silver-green, slender body, and he
seems to fade into his surroundings even as you look at him.  If you
look closely at him, you see the gill slits on his ribs, which allow
him to breathe easily underwater.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 wetfish

Mobs.Name: swanmay
Mobs.LongDescription: The snowy white swanmay glides on the surface of the water.
Mobs.Description:
The swanmay in her swan form is striking in her beauty and grace.  She
is a pure white, and moves smoothly across the water.  You sense that
she will not allow evil to intrude on the beauty of the lake, and in
her human form she may be a fierce warrior.

Mobs.Name: swordfish
Mobs.LongDescription: The swordfish attacks you, brandishing his sword with great vigor!
Mobs.Description:
This sword fish is much larger than you are!  It's 15' (4.6 meters)
long and weighs about 1000 pounds (454 kg).  It is all muscle and grace
in the water.  The front third of the fish is its sword, which could
easily ram you through.  It is a flat sort of sword, but still quite
sharp both at the point and on the edges.  You hope it is after the
herring and not you!

Mobs.Name: nessie watermonster
Mobs.LongDescription:
Her long graceful neck rising slowly up from the water, Nessie gazes
down at your puny form far below her.
Mobs.Description:
Having tired of being pursued in that *other* lake where she used to
live, Nessie has settled here in Tynstri, where things magical are
accepted.  She is an extremely large water monster, with a fairly small
head on top of a long muscular neck.  Her body is large and graceful in
the water.  She is shy for a monster, and would prefer not to be
disturbed.

Mobs.Name: scorpion water
Mobs.LongDescription: The water scorpion eyes you scornfully as she waits for tastier prey.
Mobs.Description:
The water scorpion has strongly grasping foreclaws to hold her victim
still while it is being eaten.  Her long curly tail enables her to
breathe beneath the water, although it is unusual to see her actually
*in* the water.  She is usually to be found on the bank, waiting for a
lunch to swim by.

Mobs.Name: strider skater bug
Mobs.LongDescription: The water strider zips across the surface of the water.
Mobs.Description:
The water strider, or pond skater, has a long narrow body and six
spidery legs. Unlike the other water bugs, it never ventures
underwater. Its underside is covered with a water-repellent coat of
hair that keeps it afloat. Its middle legs propel it across the
surface, its hindlegs act as rudders and brakes, and its short forelegs
are used exclusively for catching prey - like you!

Mobs.Name: water bug giant
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant water bug paralyzes the fish with its poison, then eyes you!
Mobs.Description:
This is the biggest water bug you have ever seen!  This waterbug is 40"
(100 cm) long.   It has two retractable appendages that, when held
together, form a breathing tube. It is  a strong flyer and formidable
hunter. It will paralyze its prey (you) by injecting a poison through
the beak, and in this manner it can overpower fish twice its own size.

Mobs.Name: oyster
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge oyster snaps its shell shut with a silent BANG!
Mobs.Description:
The pearl inside this oyster must be ENORMOUS judging from the size of
the grayish white deeply ridged shell.  As the huge bivalve opens its
valve, the current formed by the rapidly moving hairs covering its
gills draws you relentlessly towards it.  You wonder what it would feel
like to be eaten by an oyster.

Mobs.Name: yellow jacket bee bug
Mobs.LongDescription: "Hey, you!" says the yellow jacket.  "Yeah, YOU!  With the ugly armor!"
Mobs.Description:
The yellow jacket hornet, or wasp, likes living near to the monastery.
It buzzes around the compost heap and enjoys scaring away silly
adventurers who stumble into its part of the garden.  Very proud of its
bright yellow and black striped jacket, it enjoys verbally abusing
adventurers who drop by.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say Ha! You couldn't hit a fly if it landed on your nose!;%1 
raspberry;%1 say even if you could hit me, idiot child, you're such a 
wimp you'd be instant toast :P

Mobs.Name: drider
Mobs.LongDescription: The drider weaves his evil web between two plants.  You're trapped!
Mobs.Description:
In the drider, the body of an elf who has gone over to the dark side
has combined with the 8 long spindly legs of a spider into a kind of
evil spiderelf creature.

Mobs.Name: thri-kreen bug mantis warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: The mantis warrior looks hungrily at you.
Mobs.Description:
The thri-kreen is roughly 7' (over 2m) tall at the shoulder, with six
arms/legs and enormous black eyes that seem to twirl in their sockets.
He is covered in a thick exoskeleton which rivals the hardest armor you
have seen on your many travels.  He looks at you with keen interest, as
if attempting to decide what to do with you.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle
Mobs.LongDescription: The monastery gargoyle glares menacingly at garden intruders.
Mobs.Description:
The gargoyle is small and ugly beyond belief.  His golden-brown skin is
covered with a sparse coating of dull black hair.  He has a wide,
mobile mouth, but his grin has a strongly evil twitch to it.  His
small, deepset gray eyes watch you suspiciously.

Mobs.Name: snapdragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The snapdragon *snaps!* at you!
Mobs.Description:
The deep purple color of the snapdragon is almost enough to make you
ignore the powerful jaws and bend over to sniff at it.  But you decide
you like your nose and would rather keep it for now.  The snapdragon
(antirrhinum majus) is, like all the plants in the monastery gardens,
unusually large and fortunately for you, quite content to grow and look
pretty.  At least, as long as you keep your nose outta his face!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 snap

Mobs.Name: tiger lily
Mobs.LongDescription: The tiger lily roars beautifully.
Mobs.Description:
The tiger lily (lilium lancifolium) purrs loudly in the sunshine.  She
knows her beautifully spotted orange flowers make her the queen of this
section of the gardens.  Besides, none of the other flowers have teeth
quite as long or as sharp as hers.

Mobs.Name: elf brother dionysos
Mobs.LongDescription: Brother Dionysos thoughtfully tastes the caraway wine.
Mobs.Description:
Brother Dionysos tells you he's studying to be a wine taster.  He
samples each of the monastery's many wines on a daily basis, often
finishing late at night and actually er ... sleeping over his work.  He
has volunteered for this duty saying piously that it's a difficult job,
but someone has to do it.

Mobs.Name: blond dryad strawberry nymph
Mobs.LongDescription: Strawberry blond hair flies in a blur as the dryad whirls, dancing.
Mobs.Description:
This wood nymph has hair an unusual color of pale red.  She is normally
the first to disappear when strangers find her part of the forest, but
she becomes at times very absorbed with her feelings of communion with
her tree and with the dance she performs to celebrate it.

Mobs.Name: elf brother cleaning
Mobs.LongDescription: The cleaning brother is scrubbing hard at the gray stone.
Mobs.Description:
He looks busy.  With all the monks coming and going from dirt paths and
gardening, the grey stone floor of the monastery gets quite dirty.  It
is this monk's job to restore it to its natural cool gray color.

Mobs.Name: elf brother wine master
Mobs.LongDescription: The wine master turns the tap, pouring a bit of clear red wine.
Mobs.Description:
The wine master is constantly testing and adjusting the wines which are
fermenting in this room.  Winemaking is more of an art - a magical art
here at the monastery - than a science.  Wines are made from many of
the fruit grown here at the monastery - not only the grapes.  The wine
master is a short, stout elf who wears a leather jacket over his habit
in the chill basement air.

Mobs.Name: elf brother russ
Mobs.LongDescription:
Brother Russ mumbles, "Waxing moon, waning moon? How could I forget
so soon?"
Mobs.Description:
Brother Russ is a bit scatterbrained.  It is he who orders when
planting should start for certain crops, and when harvest should occur.
He instructs the young novices on the uses of herbs and their
relationship to magic and rainbows.

Mobs.Name: elf brother john
Mobs.LongDescription: Brother John  quietly weeps.  Why are you weeping, Brother John?
Mobs.Description:
Brother John is a tall, stooped elderly monk.  When he was very young,
a great sorceress foretold of his pivotal role in the Great Dragon
Plague that would nearly wipe Tynstri from the face of the world.  He
has
dedicated his life to living up to this prophecy and if he is
occasionally sad, perhaps that is his right.

Mobs.Name: elf brother novice monk gardener
Mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk is chanting magical phrases as he weeds the garden.
Mobs.Description:
The young elf joined the wiccan monastery drawn by its magic and the
chance to work more closely with nature.  He has studied hard, and part
of his studies includes his work in the garden, weeding.  He is
practicing the spells he has been learning as he weeds.  As he is as
yet imperfect at them, some of the results are unexpected.

Mobs.Name: dragonfly pest insect
Mobs.LongDescription: The dragonfly zooms swiftly from place to place, amazingly agile.
Mobs.Description:
The dragonfly looks like a glowing lavendar broomhandle with 4 wings
made of sheer silk.  The long narrow wings are placed two per side
almost on top of each other.  This insect is much faster than his
heavier cousins, the dragons.

Mobs.Name: lightning bug insect lightningbug
Mobs.LongDescription: The lightning bug glows with a pale green light.
Mobs.Description:
The lightning bug sheds just enough light to see when it's dark,
turning its lantern on and off to conserve its energy.  Although
normally a small, relatively harmless insect, the bug has been affected
by the wiccan magic and may now be considered "armed and dangerous"!

Mobs.Name: garter snake
Mobs.LongDescription: The little garter snake tries to blend into his surroundings.
Mobs.Description:
The small garter snake is here looking for mice and other small
rodents.  He slithers rapidly from plant to plant, hoping you won't
notice him.

Mobs.Name: elf shopper
Mobs.LongDescription: The elven woman hurries through her shopping.
Mobs.Description:
This tall young elf reluctantly left her forest home to come in to town
for some supplies - some special medicines from Seymour, some sweets
for her youngest and a new hat for herself.   Coming to town forces her
to mix with some non-elves, and she is not fond of that.

Mobs.Name: runner elf
Mobs.LongDescription:
Running in circles around the park, the lean, strong elf is keeping
fit.
Mobs.Description:
Dressed in short, soft dark green pants, the elf makes his circuit of
the park over and over, around and around, building up his strength and
stamina.  He chants a magical spell as he runs to help him keep up his
pace.

Mobs.Name: shadow
Mobs.LongDescription: The shadow slips silently along, spying for his master.
Mobs.Description:
The shadow has been well trained in the art of espionage.  A former
assassin, he will work for whomever pays him the most.  He is called
the shadow because of his uncanny ability to move unseen among groups
of elves.  For whom is he spying?  We may never know.

Mobs.Name: fire ants bugs
Mobs.LongDescription: Fire ants march towards you like an unstoppable red river.
Mobs.Description:
The fire ants - hundreds of them - move together like one gigantic war
machine.  They devour everything  that lies in their path.  When those
in the front ranks are killed, the ones in the back merely march over
them and continue on their way, killing all with their fiery sting.

Mobs.Name: novice monk
Mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk studies nature, determined to harness its power.
Mobs.Description:
Young male elves dedicate their lives to learning the wiccan way.
There is great power in the magic at the monastery, and they are bound
only by the law to do no harm.  The monks work long hours in the
gardens and on travels, gathering seeds and sprouts to bring back to
their garden.

Mobs.Name: yeti
Mobs.LongDescription: The yeti watches you curiously.
Mobs.Description:
Over 6' (2m) tall and 300 lbs (136 kg), the yeti has a very ferocious
appearance.  He is covered with a matted, dirty white fur.  His
enormous feet end in long, thick sharp claws.  The yeti has long,
powerful arms which dangle down close to his knees and end in massive,
meaty hands.  For all his strength, the yeti would prefer not to be
seen.

Mobs.Name: elf woman
Mobs.LongDescription: Absorbed by her own thoughts, the elven woman seems not to notice you.
Mobs.Description:
The elven woman seems abstracted.  Tiny by elf standards, she is only
about 5' (1.6 meters) tall.  Her pale blond hair hangs in soft curls
half-way down her back, and her ice blue eyes are weary.

Mobs.Name: elf man
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf is making a rare trip into town to trade herbs for armor.
Mobs.Description:
On a rare jaunt into town, this elven man has brought herbs and plants
to trade with Seymour for cash to buy clothing and other items.  He is
a serious looking elf, with golden blond hair, grey/green eyes and pale
golden skin.

Mobs.Name: hawthorn tree
Mobs.LongDescription: #GThe hawthorn tree bends her weary branches toward you.#N
Mobs.Description:
The hawthorn, also known as the Witches' Tree seems to watch you as you
walk along the path.  Hawthorns were once believed to be the
transformed bodies of witches, who had shapeshifted into tree form.  Is
the tree moving of its own accord or is it the breeze?

Mobs.Name: dryad singing nymph
Mobs.LongDescription: The earth stops to listen while the forest nymph sings.
Mobs.Description:
This dryad is quite tall, with waist length chestnut colored hair,
emerald green eyes and fair, almost milk-white skin.  She sings
accompanied by the soft notes of the lute which she plays.

Mobs.Name: trout fish
Mobs.LongDescription:
The rainbow-colored trout is easy to see in the quiet underwater
colors.
Mobs.Description:
The trout looks as if it were dipped in a rainbow.  Bright stripes of
magenta, pink, deep rose, violet, blue, green and yellow adorn his
short, agile body.  The trout looks good enough to eat!

Mobs.Name: herring
Mobs.LongDescription: The herring darts about the much larger fish.
Mobs.Description:
Not a very large fish, this gray-green herring is about 18" (45cm)
long.  He is doing his best to hide among the larger fish, who pay no
attention to him.  Rumor has it that whole populations of arctic elves
have lived on a combination of herring and milk.  Here's the herring.
Got milk?

Mobs.Name: elf chef cook
Mobs.LongDescription: The chief chef of the monastery sharpens his carving knife.
Mobs.Description:
You hope the rumors you have heard about the elven chef at the
monastery are not true. This sturdily built elf has muscles that would
look large on a minotaur.  What magic has made him this strong? It is
no wonder that the assassins are attempting to kidnap him.

Mobs.Name: viper snake
Mobs.LongDescription: The small but deadly viper whips swiftly towards you.
Mobs.Description:
This small snake has an evil look about him.  He moves so swiftly that
you barely have time to run through your mental list of poisonous vs
non-poisonous snakes before he attacks you.

Mobs.Name: monk serious elf
Mobs.LongDescription: Chanting quietly to himself, the monk considers his vows seriously.
Mobs.Description:
A serious student of nature and magic and the magic within nature, this
monk spends his days faithfully carrying out his duties as a monk of
the wiccan order.  He is tall and gaunt with a long narrow beard that
reaches nearly to his waist.  His head is totally bald.  He wears no
headcovering at all, preferring to feel the rain or sunshine that
nature sends on the bare skin of his scalp.

Mobs.Name: dryad graceful
Mobs.LongDescription: A graceful dryad is lost in communion with her tree.
Mobs.Description:
This lovely dryad has hair of a deep green and her skin is a pale 
spring leaf color.  Although she looks quite young, she is nearly of 
an age with the ancient trees whom she worships.  She communes with
the spirits of the trees and is fierce in their defense.

Mobs.Name: dryad singing nymph
Mobs.LongDescription: The dryad sings ancient elven songs of incredible power and beauty.
Mobs.Description:
This tiny dryad has hair the color of the bark on a black walnut 
tree and skin nearly as white as the first snow of winter.  There
is such incredible beauty in her voice that, although the words 
are in some ancient elven tongue, you know they are magic.

Mobs.Name: Jasper dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The crystalline dragon glares fiercely at you, protecting his family.
Mobs.Description:
Jasper has declared this area to be HIS, mainly because his dear 
Chaora has chosen to nest here.  There are many large eggs here ...
eggs a bit larger than you are.  Although few will hatch, all are 
precious to Jasper.

Mobs.Name: Chaora dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful violet dragon dressed in black lace waits for something.
Mobs.Description:
Chaora was named after the beautiful mineral Chaorite.  A beautiful
violet color, she is related to both the great purple dragon and 
to Pinky.  Unhappy with life in the dragon caves, she has chosen to
hatch her clutch right here in the trees.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%05 emote carefully polishes her scales.; %5 fashion; %2 hum

Mobs.Name: Malachi dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Malachi seems to be in constant motion, a swirl of green color.
Mobs.Description:
Malachi has deep green, rough crocodile skin, with sworls of other
greens.  He is constantly restless, unwilling to settle down.  He
is large, but no larger than most dragons, which is to say, of course,
QUITE large.  If he was willing to talk to you (which he is not), he
could tell you about his extensive travels ...

Objects.Name: elven mithril chainmail
Objects.Description: A small pile of mithril has been abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Yet another example of fine elven craftsmanship, this chainmail was made
of purest mithril forged into thin, fine links which were then woven
tightly together.  The result is a magnificent piece of armor that is
light in weight but very strong.

Objects.Name: boots leather
Objects.Description:
Tough brown leather boots that lace to your knee stand waiting to be
worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These deep brown dragonskin boots are made to be laced tightly up 
your calf.  Of elven origin, they have been enchanted by the master
herbalist to last comfortably an entire elven life span.

Objects.Name: shield cap'n ranger buckler
Objects.Description:
A round buckler shield suitable for an active fighter is waiting to be
claimed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Fighting dragons means somehow staying shielded from their horrible
fiery breath, yet rangers need to be nimble and to move about easily in
the forest.  Not for them the heavy mighty battle shields of knights!
Instead, elven rangers use a small, round light shield made of mithril.
This one has been engraved with a slogan in tiny letters on the side
facing the enemy.
Remember! Only YOU can prevent forest fires!

Objects.Name: magical ball wildfire light
Objects.Description: A ball of wildfire throws with both warmth and light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This magical ball will follow you wherever you go
illuminating your surroundings. The fire within the ball
burns wildly, barely controlled by the magic that locks 
it in place. Touch it carefully lest it scorch you!

Objects.Name: hunting knife master ranger
Objects.Description:
A sharp but strangely noble hunting knife waits for someone to take it
hunting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Passed down from ranger generation to ranger generation, this knife is
one of the Master Ranger's most prized possessions.  Forged by
Horatio's great grandfather and scrupulously cared for by each
generation of ranger, the hunting knife is an invaluable tool for its
owner.

Objects.Name: tree
Objects.Description:
Henrietta's home is a massive ancient tree with rough deeply-furrowed
bark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very ancient tree seems sentient, as if you could talk to it and
ask it questions.  It is covered with a very rough bark that is the
darkest shade of brown you have ever seen.

The tree bark is an unusually dark brown, with deep folds and sworls.
A bit above your head, the sworls form themselves into a deep knothole.

Objects.Name: leaves bunch
Objects.Description: The bunch of leaves is happy to be out of its knothole.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Just an ordinary bunch of leaves, very attached to their twig.
Although the twig is no longer attached to any tree, the leaves are
glossy and green and the twig is supple.

Objects.Name: twig key
Objects.Description: "I'm just an ordinary old twig," sings the twig.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like an ordinary old twig!

Objects.Name: dress henrietta
Objects.Description:
Henrietta's long black velvet dress is fastened by silver lacings that
pull it tight around her waist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Henrietta likes to wear this long black velvet dress.  It is cut low
and square at the neck with silver lacings to cinch it tight around her
waist and long sleeves that come to a point over her hand.  The sleeve
edgings are trimmed in silver lace.

Objects.Name: Anastasia stuffed purple dragon
Objects.Description:
Annie's big stuffed purple dragon tries to look fierce.  It glows
reassuringly in the dark, its belly covered with stars.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stuffed dragon is a well-loved child's toy and as she was growing
up Annie often staged mock battles with it.  Annie always won.  This
particular dragon is about 18" (45cm) tall, with a long tail dragging
behind her.  She has shiny light pink wings and a long, forked tongue.
Annie has named her Anastasia.

Objects.Name: socks purple
Objects.Description: Annie has carelessly left her purple socks on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These soft socks were hand-knitted from the finest of wool by Annie's
grandmother.  There is a faint pattern of stars glowing in the socks.

Objects.Name: star key
Objects.Description: A shining star the size of an elven thumb looks forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
About the size of a normal elven thumb, this star shape has a faint
glow about it.  It reminds you of something ...

Objects.Name: ancient elven ring
Objects.Description: The ancient elven ring holds many mysteries waiting to be discovered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ring is a wide circle of gold, deeply engraved.  On the outside of
the ring appears the symbol of the dragon, perhaps in memory of the
time dragons and elves fought together.  On the inside there is a
mysterious spell engraved in an ancient elven tongue and one is
reminded that the elves are the "first people".

Objects.Name: fire opal ring
Objects.Description: The small fire opal captured a lick of the dragon's fire.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fire opal on a ring of gold glows with the dragon's breath.

Objects.Name: sign
Objects.Description:
A small sign calls attention to itself by its bright colors of magenta
and lemon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #mWatch out for #ylow flying #mdragons.

Objects.Name: wings gryphon fur feathers
Objects.Description:
Looking oddly out of place and unnaturally still, the combination of
fur and feathers wants to fly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Large strong wings in a golden auburn color properly belong to the
powerful gryphon.  Although the business part of the wing is covered
with long, sturdy feathers, the upper edge of the wing is covered with
a dense, thick mat of fur over sleek lithe muscles.  The wings combine
strength with agility and beauty.

Objects.Name: staff healing hawthorn heart
Objects.Description: A tall staff carved from the heart of the hawthorn obstructs your path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Covered with runes and magical carvings, this staff has been carved
from the very heart of the witches' tree, the hawthorn.

Objects.Name: ornate gold ring
Objects.Description: An elaborately carved heavy gold ring looks too heavy to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very solid ring made from pure gold and forged by the gold dragon
himself.  He has deeply engraved it with his own likeness.  Dragons
tend to be a bit vain, and the gold dragon doesn't hesitate to remind
you that he has a heart of purest gold.  He uses this ring as a signet
ring, which means he presses it into sealing wax as his symbol.  He
never learned to write his name without singeing the paper.

Objects.Name: Chastity braided narrow belt leather
Objects.Description:
A narrow belt braided from many different leathers stretches out on
the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed of countless small threads of leather woven in an intricate
design to be sturdy and flexible, the belt is an excellent example of
elven craftsmanship.  The many different varieties of leather in the
belt add color and strength to the belt and the wearer.

Objects.Name: cloak shadow shadows
Objects.Description: Something almost unseen shadows the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Like a sudden mist, the cloak of shadows conceals without having any
substance of its own.  It is gray.  It is white.  It is black.  It is
without color or being, but with its folds it covers and warms and
protects.

Objects.Name: icicle
Objects.Description: A long, sharply pointed icicle chills the air around it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed by an evil mage cold to the marrow of his bones, this icicle
will never melt.  Its wicked point will slide easily into the heart of
your enemy.

Objects.Name: belt purple
Objects.Description: A l-o-n-g stripe of deepest purple ends in an elaborate silver buckle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dark purple belt has been engraved with a pattern of dragons
frolicking joyfully.  The clasp at one end is made of silver.  The belt
is quite long.

Objects.Name: leg plates legplates
Objects.Description: These leg plates seem to glow with a faint bluish sheen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The legplates on closer inspection are made of tiny overlapping slices
of pale blue aquamarine.  The crystal provides good protection against
normal weaponry, and is so beautiful it enhances the wearer's sense of
well-being.

Objects.Name: amethyst ankle bracelet chain
Objects.Description: Pale amethysts on a chain of gold glow quietly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Clear violet amethysts have been grouped together on a golden chain.
The amethysts vary greatly in size, shape and coloration.  At the
center of the chain is an enormous heart-shaped amethyst in a deep
purple color.

Objects.Name: cloak shiny white bundle
Objects.Description: A large bundle of white shines up at you, screaming, "Pick me up!"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very long cloak reaches from your neck to your toes.  The heavy
shiny white substance forming the cloak has a strange rock-like feel to
it, yet the cloak floats gracefully with you as you walk or fight.

Objects.Name: armplates emerald scale green abandoned
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of emerald scale armplates
Objects.Description: Something very large and very green has evidently been abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed of thick, flat scales of solid deep green emerald, the armplates
are heavy armor, solid protection against attack.  Definitely good gear
for a fierce warrior!

Objects.Name: topaz bracelet circlet
Objects.Description: A circlet of topaz awaits its rightful owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A favorite item of the topaz dragon, I'm sure it will be missed by him.
The bracelet is a solid circle of glowing yellow topaz.  When it
catches the morning light the effect is nearly blinding.

Objects.Name: Crystal Trident
Objects.Description:
A short three pronged spear made of solid crystal is ready to attack
someone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The crystal dragon formed this three-pronged spear from solid crystal.
The sharp, thin prongs of the trident will slide easily between the
ribs of its victim.  The crystal warms with use, enjoying its evil
purpose.  Put away, it gradually grows cold and brittle.

Objects.Name: glowing golden vial
Objects.Description: The small golden vial has a strange glow about it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vial feels warm to the touch.  When you enclose it in your palm, it
feels right, somehow.  The glow warms you.  There are no markings on
the vial to indicate what is inside, but you are reassured by the "HH"
engraved on the bottom.

Objects.Name: ruby scale shield
Objects.Description: The shield left lying on the ground glows with a ruby fire.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed from a large breast scale of the mighty ruby dragon, this shield
will protect you as it protected the dragon.  The deep red glow it
provides is almost warm enough to ward off a winter's chill.

Objects.Name: Bubbas tattered overalls
Objects.Description: Small tears and colorful patches cover the enormous overalls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bubba's favorite overalls look somewhat the worse for wear.  Bubba is
the largest of the baby dragons, and slightly embarassed about his
size.  He is very active, and the dragon master gave him these overalls
to provide some protection to his rapidly expanding dragon skin.  Bubba
has found that the patches seem to give him an added bounce to his
step.

Objects.Name: gnomish walking tunic
Objects.Description: A long leather walking tunic has been removed from its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tough leather tunic favored by gnomish scientists for its many
pockets.  The gnomes stuff them with magnifying glasses, bits of string
and other stuff loved only by the gnomish.

Objects.Name: studly vest
Objects.Description: Unthinkable! Someone has left a very studly vest just lying around!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the vest every young (dragon) stud has to have!  Slip your arms
into it and let it hang loose.  This is the vest of your dreams!

Objects.Name: jackrabbit shoes
Objects.Description: A bit of grayish fur seems to be stuck to the shoes left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jackrabbit has an amazingly powerful jump, and he owes some of this
kick to his specially made shoes.

Objects.Name: slippers sunshine
Objects.Description:
A pair of sunny yellow slippers with bright red smiley faces painted on
them are tucked neatly in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Sunshine is a very cute baby dragon and she is even cuter with these
little slippers on her baby dragon feet.  Swipe once stole them from
her to see if it would make her cry, but the dragon master made him
give them back.

Objects.Name: arm plates armplates mithril
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of mithril arm plates
Objects.Description: The shiny white glint of elven-forged mithril catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These beautifully made armplates were a present to an elf on the
occasion of his heading out into the world on a Great Adventure.  They
were forged by Horatio, master of arms in Tynstri, and carefully marked
with protective runes by the elf's family.

Objects.Name: tattoo studly
Objects.Description:
A gold and silver tattoo of a sexy mud dragon could be burned into your
arm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Tattoos are an "in" thing among this generation of dragon males.  This
one shows a very beautiful gold and silver female dragon. When properly
placed, when the young stud flexes the dragon appears to dance
seductively.

Objects.Name: key palace gold
Objects.Description: A bit of gold glitters on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A glittering gold key will allow you access to the palace.

Objects.Name: cureall cure-all potion
Objects.Description:
A cure-all potion struts around, proud as a peacock, but twice as
cheap.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This amazing little potion will cure your poison, cure your bellyache,
your headache, your fallen arches!  It will make the blind see again
and the cursed return to their normal state of grace.  And all for such
a paltry sum.

Objects.Name: runed bracers
Objects.Description: The heavily marked pair of bracers appears to hum to itself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of a supple leather from some unknown beast, the bracers are
covered with runes.  Some have been stamped into the leather with some
metal tool, some burned in and some have been marked with ink.

Objects.Name: gentle death staff
Objects.Description: A highly polished black staff hovers gently above the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A smoothly polished black staff of volcanic glass sparkles with energy.
Obviously it WANTS to be used.

Objects.Name: sudden death wand
Objects.Description: A dark black wand attempts to fade into non-existence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of black coal ripped from the earth by dragon fire, the wand will
twice perform it's evil task (murder most foul) before it may sink
back into the ground.

Objects.Name: fatal charm rod
Objects.Description:
A short rod of brilliant light glows in front of you, warming the
cockles of your heart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Something about this beautiful wand just makes you feel good.  You want
to hold it close to you and never use it, lest it's warmth fade.

Objects.Name: black velvet slippers
Objects.ShortDescription: black velvet slippers with long pointy toes
Objects.Description:
Two slippers made of thick black velvet are sitting neatly side by
side.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Henrietta's slippers are made of a thick, strong velvet with a long nap
that needs to be brushed at least once a week.  The velvet is inlaid
with thin gold stripes, and the insides of the slippers have been
dusted with herbs (to combat foot odor).  In true wizard fashion, the
toes of these slippers appear to go on forever in a long graceful curl.

Objects.Name: gnomish walking stick
Objects.Description: A slightly crooked but sturdy stick lies in wait for you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A rather short but sturdy stick for the adventurous gnome.  The smart
scientist pokes his stick into a strange hole first, rather than his
finger!  That's why most gnomes still have all 10 fingers in spite of
their many experiments and their adventurous research.

Objects.Name: bunch violets
Objects.Description: A sweet nosegay of violets is held together with a pretty white ribbon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small bunch of violets has been gathered and tied together with a
thin white satin ribbon.  The violets are a deep velvety purple color.

Objects.Name: bandana orange
Objects.Description: The orange bandana is so bright it practically shrieks, "PICK ME UP!"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Young dragons are usually forced to wear soft pastel "baby" colors, and
by the time they reach adolescence they usually hate those colors and
long for the deep tones of adult dragons.  One group has chosen these
fiery orange bandanas as their symbol.

Objects.Name: bandana red scrap scarlet
Objects.Description: A small scrap of scarlet has been forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a group of dragons who have banded together to stamp out
elves.  The elves are a threat to the continuation of dragonkind, they
reason, with their dragon-hunters and the bounty on dragonhides.  They
call themselves DragonFire, and wear the red bandana.

Objects.Name: box elf crackers
Objects.ShortDescription: a small box of elf crackers
Objects.Description:
Slightly sweet crackers shaped like elves fill a small brown box that
looks like a little tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Baby dragons love these little crackers.  Some are shaped like elf
wizards, some like monks.  They love to bite the head off the master
ranger, and chew each foot off of Henrietta Hennapy, one at a time 
to make her last.

Objects.Name: food candy jelly beans candies
Objects.Description: Some small egg-shaped brightly colored candies are scattered here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jellybeans look like tiny eggs from some exotic tropical bird.
They seem to come in an infinite variety of colors and flavors, but all
are extremely sweet.

Objects.Name: food cookies crumbs
Objects.Description: Some yummy oatmeal cookies look a bit crumbly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before being mashed up in someone's pocket, these used to be very tasty
oatmeal cookies!

Objects.Name: leggings elvenkind
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of leggings of elvenkind
Objects.Description: Someone has shed his leggings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick leather leggings made for elven rangers must provide adequate
protection against the fierce predators that lurk in the forest, yet
not restrict a ranger's movements.  Rangers may need to climb trees,
race through underbrush, or perform other feats requiring great
agility.  These leggings were made with all of that in mind.

Objects.Name: armband silver snake ssnake sssilver
Objects.Description:
A sssapphire-eyed sssilver sssnake wantsss to wind itssself around 
your arm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Out of the corner of your eye, you see a forked tongue slither 
quickly out of the snake's mouth.  The sapphire eye glitters.  Of
dwarven origin and craftmanship, you think, for the engraving and
delicate workmanship of this silver snake is very lifelike.

Objects.Name: girth forests
Objects.Description: The dragonhide girth has been fitted with a large brass buckle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An elven tanner took the thick skin of an emerald dragon and cured
it slowly, then shaped it into a wide girth and added a buckle
made of brass.

Objects.Name: garlic herb potion bulb
Objects.ShortDescription: a small white bulb of garlic
Objects.Description: A small white bulb of garlic might keep the vampires away!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small, innocent looking herb conceals a very pungent scent when
eaten.  Perhaps this is the source of its legendary powers of keeping
villains at bay.

Objects.Name: bark willow wand
Objects.Description: Some bark has been torn off a willow tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like bark torn loose from some tree.

Objects.Name: forget-me-not flower scroll recall
Objects.Description:
The soft blue petals of the forget-me-not are the color of the sky on a
summer morning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jellie gives Flyn one of these flowers every morning so he'll always
have an easy way home.

Objects.Name: dragoncrown crown gold
Objects.Description: A small, heavy crown glistens on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A crown made only for dragon mobs.

Objects.Name: hunting bow twohand ranger weapon
Objects.Description:
Only a ranger who is a master of his craft and pure of heart may wield
this mighty weapon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wood for the Master Ranger's Great Hunting Bow was given to his
ancestor by a grateful forest at the time of the first dragon invasion
countless millenia ago. Modern rangers added mithril-tipped arrows
dipped in a poison know only to members of their craft.

Objects.Name: potion nasty
Objects.Description: A really nasty looking potion in a grimy glass bottle sits undisturbed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Why is it that the stuff that's good for you always has to taste so
bad?  This is undoubtedly good for you, but feels really evil goin'
down.  This is a kind of lumpy pinkish goo.

Objects.Name: flask juice carrot
Objects.Description: It looks like something yummy and very orange!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Elves have mastered the use of the gifts of nature.  The juice in this
clear flask will undoubtedly help your vision.

Objects.Name: milk bota
Objects.Description: A bota made from well-cured dragonskin could hold a lot to drink.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bota is a drink container, made for wine by the monks on the
hilltop monastery.  It is a graceful teardrop shape, soft and
capacious.  The rounded bottom tapers to a thin neck, closed with a
stopper which is attached to the body of the bota by a short cord.
This particular bota is made of dragon skin, which is particularly
thick and has insulating properties much needed by the dragons while
they are alive.  This skin shimmers with rainbow colors.

Objects.Name: essence bugloss bottle
Objects.Description:
A small stoppered bottle containing the distilled essence of viper's
bugloss waits here in case you need it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clear glass bottle looks like it would fit handily into a
backpack, satchel or girdle.   It is filled with a nasty-smelling
liquid, black in color.  There is a gold label on the bottle with very
formal black lettering.  It reads, "Quaff in case of attack by viper."

Objects.Name: viper bugloss leaves
Objects.ShortDescription: a few leaves from the bugloss plant
Objects.Description: Some leaves have fallen off the viper's bugloss plant.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The leaves are a deep green covered with fine white hairs.

Objects.Name: vipers bugloss plant
Objects.ShortDescription: a pretty bush covered with prickly hairs
Objects.Description: A row of viper's bugloss makes a prickly but appealing sight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Viper's Bugloss. Echium vulgare. A showy plant covered with prickly
hairs. An infusion made from 1 ounce of dried leaves to one pint of
water makes a good cordial that relieves headaches and nervous
complaints and alleviates fevers. The plant is said to be an expeller
of poisons and venoms and could even cure a viper's bite, hence the
name.

Objects.Name: trout food fish
Objects.Description: The brightly colored fish looks dipped in Heaven's colors.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The lovely fish looks very tasty as it slides through the cold waters
of the lake.  It swims, stripes of magenta, cyan, green and daffodil
adding color to the water.

Objects.Name: tankard
Objects.Description: The tankard of ale looks coolly refreshing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tall tin tankard gleams with the cold condensation covering its
sides.  The ale smells flower sweet.

Objects.Name: forget-me-not tincture potion
Objects.Description: The forget-me-not potion helps you recall places far away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pale blue elixir made from the petals of the forget-me-not plant
(myosotis sylvatica) has the qualities of helping you remember things
from long ago.  For example, think of the place you were born.  Quaff
the potion and *boing* you are there!

Objects.Name: thumbscrew circle leather brass ring
Objects.Description: An odd looking circle of leather and brass catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring of copper and leather looks very uncomfortable to wear.
Tightening the ring to fit your thumb drives a small copper screw into
the flesh of your thumb.  (Ouch!)  If it was a present you might want
to think twice about the person who gave it to you.  If you bought it
for yourself ... well ...

Objects.Name: gown dryad green
Objects.Description:
A whisper light gown in shades of leaf green blends into the forest
floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Light enough to float on the mention of a breeze, the cloth was woven
with magic from the flowers in the dryad's sylvan glade.  The length
magically adjusts itself so that the bottom floats near the wearer's
ankles. The sleeves are loose and long.  The cloth is a wispy delicate
fabric whose strength comes from the charms chanted into it.

Objects.Name: robe dryad colorful butterfly
Objects.ShortDescription: a robe woven of butterfly wings
Objects.Description:
A brightly colored robe with the delicate colors and markings of
butterflies looks ready to take off and fly away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At first you think the robe was woven from live butterflies.  The cloth
with which it was made is delicate and light and moves with the
slightest breath of air.  It is painted with the same colors as the
butterflies from the dryad's forest glade, and has the same delicate
markings.

Objects.Name: pool lake
Objects.Description: The lake looks deep, but clear and cold and refreshing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The water looks clear enough to drink.  This is the largest lake in
Tynstri, and furnishes much of the food for inhabitants and visitors.  It
provides a habitat for the aquatic elves who live here, and is home to
a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.

Objects.Name: collar pearl studded
Objects.Description:
Oddly, the cat's collar appears to be studded with pearls which glow
with an unusual brightness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An unusually expensive collar, it must have been a present for a very
well loved cat.  The leather collar glows brightly with pearls of
wisdom.  This helps the one who wears it to learn more quickly.

Objects.Name: pearl key
Objects.Description: The glistening pearl hides quietly inside the oyster.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Small, round, white, firm, ready to be strung with others like it into
a necklace or mounted on a gold ring.

Objects.Name: bracelet nightshade
Objects.Description:
A bracelet woven of leaves of the deadly nightshade plant lies
innocently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The green leaves of the nightshade plant have been woven together to
form a bracelet.

Objects.Name: red glass bottle
Objects.ShortDescription: a red bottle made of cut glass
Objects.Description:
A tall slender red bottle made of cut glass is filled with a thick
liquid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bottle is made of many-faceted red cut glass, which reflects all
available light so that it appears to glow.  There is a label attached
to it.  In very tiny script it says, "Love potion.  Take with caution
as needed."

Objects.Name: beaker clear
Objects.Description:
A tall clear beaker with a loose cork stopper is filled with a thick,
greenish slime.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stuff inside looks disgusting, like some kind of green sludge.  So
... it must be good for you, right?

Objects.Name: wand feather
Objects.Description: The sooty black feather was plucked from the wing of a very large bird.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
About a foot (30cm) long, the feather comes to a fairly sharp point on
one end.  It is the wing feather from a very large bird, a vulture to
be precise.  Perhaps if you hold it in your hand and wave it about then
you, too, will be able to fly!

Objects.Name: shirt white vine-embellished
Objects.Description:
One of the long sleeves of this white shirt appears to have been
captured by a deep green vine.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is Seymour's favorite shirt, hand embroidered for him by Flora.
The vine wrapped tightly around his sleeve reminds him of AudreyII, his
pet plant that he raised from a small bulb.  Flora enjoys decorating
his shirts with symbols of his profession and like most other things of
elven design, this one is enhanced with magic.  You may find a similar
shirt at Rose's shop down the road a bit.  Flora made a few extras for
her to sell.

Objects.Name: trousers pants
Objects.ShortDescription: forest green trousers held up by suspenders
Objects.Description:
A pair of wide brown suspenders have firmly attached themselves to some
forest green pants.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These comfortable but sturdy trousers are the deep green of yew trees.
They fit very loosely, allowing a great feeling of freedom of movement.

Made of braided deep brown leather, the suspenders are quite strong.
The fittings are brass.

Objects.Name: tunic white leather
Objects.ShortDescription: a white tunic embellished with gold braid
Objects.Description:
A thigh length white tunic of finest elven leather has been trimmed
with gold braid and fastenings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The guards posted at the entrance to Tynstri wear this long white leather
tunic.  Some say the guards are chosen for their strength, charm,
native magical abilities and extreme good looks.  Others say that these
attributes are merely a result of their position and their uniforms.

Objects.Name: bandana bright blue sweatband
Objects.Description:
Folded into a narrow strip of bright cloth, the bandana has obviously
been used as a sweatband by some very active elf.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Once thought to keep evil thoughts from escaping (or entering) elven
heads, the bandana is now worn for decoration and to keep the hair (and
sweat) out of the eyes.  They tend to be very brightly colored, and
this one is no exception.

Objects.Name: horn warning
Objects.Description:
The horn is as long as you are tall and looks like it would make a lot
of noise if you blew it.  So don't.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Carved of blackest ebony, this is a gatewatcher's horn.  Only elven
watchers may use it.  Its loud "Braaaatatatat" warns the elves of
attack by dragons.  Blown from the height of the watchtower, the horn
may be heard throughout the kingdom.

Objects.Name: salestunic tunic tasteless
Objects.Description:
A tunic in brightly clashing shades of chartreuse, magenta and orange
stands out where it has been left.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is definitely the kind of garment that draws attention to its
wearer.  Only the colorblind could find it pleasing to the eye,
however.  Perhaps this visual offensiveness is its source of magic
armor.

Objects.Name: midnight-blue velvet robe
Objects.ShortDescription: a floor-length robe of midnight-blue velvet
Objects.Description:
The long midnight-blue velvet robe has been embroidered with faintly
glowing golden stars.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bottom of the robe barely skims the ground as you walk briskly in
these warm robes.  Of deepest midnight blue, darker than black, the
robe still has a faint glow around the shoulders and in the lining of
the deep hood.  Staring at the robe, over time you can make out a
beautiful pattern of stars.

Objects.Name: vulture eggs
Objects.Description:
The vulture's eggs are resting cozily in their little nest.  If the
eggs are here, surely their mother couldn't be far away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They are small and ovoid and contain baby vultures!  Leave them alone!

Objects.Name: unicorn horn
Objects.Description: The golden unicorn's horn is long, sharp and quite heavy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The long golden horn once graced a unicorn's head.  It is as long as an
elven arm, and swirls to a sharp point at one end.

Objects.Name: crimson tunic elven hauberk
Objects.ShortDescription: a deep crimson linen tunic and hauberk
Objects.Description:
What looks like a pool of fresh-spilled dragon's blood is only an elven
tunic.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An unusual color for the quietly reserved elves, this tunic is the deep
dark red of dragon blood, the deep crimson of a late summer rose or
holly berries in midwinter.  The tunic is made of strongly woven linen,
and is worn over a very fine, light chainmail hauberk.

Objects.Name: table oak
Objects.Description: A polished round table made of oak sits at the side of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This looks like a good size table where you and a few of your friends
could sit, have a bite to eat, and chat or read.  One wonders why Barns
& Nibble allows people to read their books while they are munching away
at food and drink that is bound to mess up their merchandise, but they
charge enough for both the food and books that they can afford to be
generous.

Objects.Name: chair oak
Objects.Description:
A sturdy oak chair looks like it would support you AND all your armor
and belongings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At last! No more sitting on the floor!  This isn't the most comfortable
of chairs, but it fits nicely under the table and is strong enough for
you and  1000 lbs (500 or so kilos) of armor and other assorted gear
that you can't leave your clan house without!

Objects.Name: lute rolands
Objects.Description: Roland's lute plays beautiful music with the right hands guiding it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This particular lute was carved from oak and inlaid with a design
formed from strips of many different varieties of wood.  The lute has 8
strings.  When Roland plays upon it, his audience is filled with a
feeling of peace and safety.

Objects.Name: peach-colored linen shirt
Objects.ShortDescription: a linen shirt the color of ripe peaches
Objects.Description:
Lying discarded here, you can see a finely woven linen shirt, soft as a
spring leaf.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The master weaver wove the linen making up this shirt from the finest,
softest flax.  It has been dyed the color of ripe peaches, and is very
soft to tender skin that rarely sees bright sunlight.

Objects.Name: pickled herring
Objects.Description: Some little fish have gotten themselves into quite a pickle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks like it used to be a nice little fish before it got pickled
and jarred.

Objects.Name: oak staff
Objects.Description:
The sturdy oaken staff looks like a strong weapon that would also make
a good walking stick.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Cut from the heart of the mighty oak tree, this staff is perfect for
the nomadic druid or monk.

Objects.Description: A map to the village and its surroundings awaits your perusal.

Objects.Name: shopping guide
Objects.Description: The village fathers have created a small guide to shopping in Tynstri.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
