Objects.Name: silk shirt
Objects.Description: A puddle of milk-colored silk has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The soft, full silk blouse is fastened down the front with a row of
tiny gold buttons, and the long sleeves end in narrow cuffs fastened
with the same type of  gold button.  The silk is a delight to the
senses, distracting the wearer and the wearer's opponents from thoughts
of battle.

Objects.Name: food candy jelly beans jellybeans candies
Objects.Description: Some small egg-shaped brightly colored candies are scattered here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jellybeans look like tiny eggs from some exotic tropical bird.
They seem to come in an infinite variety of colors and flavors, but all
are extremely sweet.

Objects.Name: food cookies
Objects.Description: Some delicious cookies are sitting on a delicate china plate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You have before you an assortment of cookies.  They are making your
mouth water.  They are shouting, "#rEat me!!!#W"

Objects.Name: drink herbal tea cup
Objects.Description: You are welcome to a refreshing cup of herbal tea.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dainty china cup is not very large, but then the tea is meant to be
sipped.  If it were to satisfy your thirst, the management would not
sell as much!

The tea has an odd but not unpleasant flavor.  Rest and a sip of this
tea will leave you feeling refreshed and ready for another battle.

Objects.Name: hat sunhat
Objects.Description:
The big floppy-brimmed sunhat protects delicate skin from the burning
rays of the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sunhat is unlike any you've ever seen before.  The crown is lined
with finely woven mithril, firmly shaped to protect against falling
branches and other hazards of forest life.  It has a very wide, loose
brim that hangs around your face.  The dryads haven't seen the
fire-breathers, their name for the dragons, but they are well-defended
if the dragons make their way to the sacred glade.

Objects.Name: longbow elven
Objects.Description:
Nearly as tall as an elf, this elven longbow is tautly strung and ready
to speed an arrow to its target.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of the earliest weapons developed by the elves, the longbow has
long had a place in their defense.  The bow makes a graceful curve of
its 5' (150cm) of length.  Light in weight, even the newest guards find
it a very effective weapon.

Objects.Name: pants white leather trousers
Objects.Description: The gate guards for Tynstri wear strong white leather trousers.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These white leather uniform pants have a deep green stripe up one side.

Objects.Name: funeral wreath flowers
Objects.ShortDescription: a wreath of flowers fit for a funeral
Objects.Description:
A lovely wreath of many flowers shows your respect for the newly
departed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This enormous wreath of flowers is actually built in more of a
horseshoe shape, with the open end at the bottom.  The flowers include
lilies and roses and bright red carnations as well as more subdued
colors.  Across the middle a wide blue ribbon proclaims, "Rest in
Peace".  This is a wreath for someone who will be deeply missed.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: An imposing statue stands at the center of a white marble fountain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At the center of the large, white marble fountain, an enormous statue
shows the #rForever #wS#yh#wi#yn#wi#yn#wg #GFlyn#W the #BMighty#W, #RAvatar #yKing #Wof #gElvenkind#W.

He looks mighty.  Flyn is a legend in his own time, and the elves
revere him as a superhero.

Objects.Name: forget-me-not flower scroll
Objects.Description:
The soft blue petals of the forget-me-not are the color of the sky on a
summer morning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jellie gives Flyn one of these flowers every morning so he'll always
have an easy way home.

Objects.Name: food fish chips
Objects.Description:
A meal of fish and chips is greasy but satisfying.  Strange fish,
though.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You don't want to look too closely at that fish.  The chips are just
normal fried potatoes.  At least, that's what they appear to be.

Objects.Name: dagger deadly
Objects.Description:
Light barely reflects off the dagger with the long narrow blade and the
rune-covered handle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Darkly evil, crafted with the singular sinister purpose of
assassination and death, this dagger has an aura of quiet menace about
it.

Objects.Name: pouch elven healer leather bag
Objects.Description: A rather scruffy looking leather bag has been tossed aside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of well-worn leather, this pouch is buckled to secure it around
the waist.  Opened, the scent of rare and mysterious herbs fills your
nostrils.  Sweet and pungent, alluring and nauseous, this pouch has
held many magic cures.

Objects.Name: knife chefs
Objects.Description:
The blade of the very sharp kitchen knife looks like it would cut your
skin easily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made to cut through flesh as easily as butter, the Superb Elven Chef
keeps his instruments so sharp they could split a hair.

Objects.Name: chair oak
Objects.Description: The sturdy oak chair has a colorful cushion tied to the seat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Quite thick, this cushion has been stuffed with soft grasses gathered
from the nearby park.  The cushion is a bright red.

Objects.Name: light bottle glowworm
Objects.Description:
Seymour has managed to bottle the essence of glowworm, providing a
reliable light source.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Try as you might, you can see no worm in the bottle.  The round glass
bottle glows greenly, providing ample light to keep you from bumping
into walls or nasty monsters.  There is a lip around the top of the
bottle.  A small circle of metal is kept in place by this lip, and
serves as anchor for the bottle's metal handle.

Objects.Name: short leather skirt
Objects.ShortDescription: a very short black leather skirt
Objects.Description: A very wide belt or a very short skirt is waiting for its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This skirt is designed to both entice and to distract.  It is VERY
short and tight enough to make it clear the wearer has nothing but bare
skin underneath.

Objects.Name: glass beer drink
Objects.Description: Have a glass o'beer, won't you, matey?!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A deep golden color, this beer is cold and looks delicious.

Objects.Name: satchel
Objects.Description:
Some poor animal of indeterminable species gave up his skin for this
satchel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Not a particularly attractive means of carting around your worldly
belongings, this satchel nevertheless is sturdy and capacious.  What
more could you require of a satchel?

Objects.Name: yellow jacket
Objects.ShortDescription: a jacket striped in yellow and black
Objects.Description:
Wide garish stripes of bright yellow and black z-z-z-i-n-g-g-g your
eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although the hornet wore this with pride he was, after all, a hornet.
In this jacket you would look like a referee for some alien kind of
game.  It does truly offend the eye!

Objects.Name: celt axe ax stone
Objects.Description:
A heavy, sharpened stone is firmly attached to a strong piece of oak
with a thick lashing of leather.

Objects.Name: puddle gold robe golden
Objects.Description: A puddle of gold catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Long and flowing, the fairies must have made these golden-hued robes
from spring flowers.  It is very delicate and not made for battle.  It
almost glows with the magic woven into its very fiber.

Objects.Name: sign
Objects.Description: A sign sits here in front of the gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It says, "Tynstri City Council has declared this to be a Dragon Free
Zone".  You wonder if that is truth or wishful thinking.

Objects.Name: flower halo circle garlands headdress
Objects.Description:
Looks like a halo of tiny flowers and sweet-smelling herbs has landed
on the ground.  Pick it up and wear it!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hundreds of tiny flowers and leaves have been woven together into a
circle, to be worn on the head.  The herbs and the incantations chanted
when the circle was woven have enhanced the beauty and the power of the
headdress.

Objects.Name: potion bottle elderberry wine
Objects.ShortDescription: a small crystal bottle of elderberry wine
Objects.Description:
A delicately engraved crystal bottle of elderberry wine has a tightly
fitting glass-and-cork stopper.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The deep red color of the wine in the crystal bottle captures your
attention.  As you gaze intently at it, mysterious images seem to
appear on the surface of the glass.

Objects.Name: green eyeshade
Objects.Description:
The dark green eyeshade is designed to keep harsh sunlight from tender
eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Like all things elven in orgin, this eyeshade has been decorated with
lovely runes which add both a touch of beauty and a touch of magic.

Objects.Name: scaly leggings lizard skin
Objects.Description: A lizard must have molted and left his skin for someone else .

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These tough leggings are made from the skin of a lizard, probably cast
off during some natural molting process, but not necessarily so.  They
are scaly and tend to itch, but provide excellent protection.

Objects.Name: chocolates box
Objects.Description: A tempting box of chocolates waits to be opened.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The box is wrapped in bright red cellophane and tied with a big gold
bow.

Objects.Name: wrist corsage flowers
Objects.ShortDescription: a cluster of tiny sweet-smelling flowers
Objects.Description: A small cluster of flowers is waiting to be tied to someone's wrist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You are uncertain of the origin of these flowers, but the scent is
delightfully refreshing.

Objects.Name: tight black leggings
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of tight black leggings
Objects.Description: The small smear of black on the ground is barely noticeable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These knitted black leggings cling like a second skin, providing
minimal protection from the elements, but a bit of warmth.

Objects.Name: skirt floral green
Objects.Description:
A swirl of dark green fabric with a faint pattern of leaves looks like
a small patch of summer on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A deep green silk has been faintly patterned with leaves by a process
unknown to you.  The deep green coloring allows the wearer to blend
into a forest setting, rendering her nearly invisible to some
predators.

Objects.Name: deerskin boots
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of soft black deerskin boots
Objects.Description:
Elven cobblers stamped strange runes into the tops of these soft
leather boots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These very soft leather boots are decorated with a series of magic
runes, which give special protection to the wearer.  The precise
meaning of the runes is known only to the cobbler, however rumor has it
they say something about the mother of all dragons.

Objects.Name: suede pants
Objects.Description:
Long, soft as silk but strong as any leather, this pair of suede pants
is waiting to be worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These pants feel outrageously soft next to your skin, the slight fuzz
of the suede gives them a very sensuous feel.  You are reassured by the
fact that they are quite tough and very well made.  They are made to be
tucked into the tops of some knee-high boots.

Objects.Name: sharkskin boots
Objects.Description:
A pair of grey sharkskin boots with long pointed toes and thick leather
soles stand ready for you to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elves make these boots themselves from sharks that elven
adventurers capture on their many voyages away from Tynstri.  The
sharkskin has a slight shine.  The toes come to a long, hard point both
as a fashion statement and as a matter of protection, but they are
difficult to learn to walk in.

Objects.Name: key wine cellar
Objects.Description: A shiny brass key lies innocently where it was dropped.

Objects.Name: chefs hat
Objects.Description:
Ack! This beautiful starched white hat is gonna get dirty on the floor.
Pick it up!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A traditional tall white hat starts with a broad, starched white band
of cloth about 6" (15cm) tall that fits snugly around the head.  A tall
poof of white explodes from the band into a balloon shape that extends
the hat by about 18" (90cm).

Objects.Name: apron chefs
Objects.Description:
The traditionally shaped chef's apron is blindingly white and starched
to a crisp smoothness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chef's apron is made from a special white cotton imported to Tynstri
and sewn here by Rose.  It is undoubtedly some powerful magic which
keeps it so clean and white.  Perhaps the magic is called "kitchen
helpers".

Objects.Name: scroll encyclopedia book
Objects.Description:
The Encyclopedia of Strange and Unusual Items looks like it might be
good reading - for the sleep-deprived.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This heavy tome contains information about just about everything you
are likely to run into in Tynstri.

Objects.Name: overalls clothing elmer
Objects.Description: Here are Elmer's sturdy overalls, lying on the ground.  Where is Elmer?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
From their tough leather straps over the shoulders to the double
stitching down the legs, these are very sturdy overalls, meant to last
for a long time for a person who hates replacing clothing he loves.
Rose was kind enough to embroider his name on the bib front.

Objects.Name: pile rainbow leggings striped
Objects.Description: All the colors of the rainbow sit here in a pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jemara's leggings reflect her freeflowing personality.  She liked these
leggings because they have every color of the rainbow in them.  They
are a trifle blinding to those unused to them, but Jamara likes them.

Objects.Name: sickle blade druid
Objects.Description:
A sharp blade shaped like the crescent moon is attached to a short
staff made of black oak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sickle was originally made for the druid who secluded himself
inside an enormous tree on the outskirts of Midgaard.  He would gather
herbs on moonlit nights and in the early morning dew.  As the woods
became more populated with adventurers, he became more of a hermit and
had no more use for this sickle.

Objects.Name: wristlet ribbon
Objects.Description:
Many colors of ribbon have been woven together to form a lovely
wristlet for you to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ribbons of many colors form an unusual pattern.  Ribbon weaving is not
a usual elven hobby, so this must have been brought in by one of the
travelers who visited Tynstri.  Wear it in good health.

Objects.Name: ring celibacy band
Objects.Description:
A wide band of bronze is intertwined with narrower bands of copper and
gold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This beautifully crafted ring is given to all novice monks to remind
them of their vows of celibacy.  Created jointly by Horatio, who does
the metal work, and Brother John, who does the chanting, the ring
squeezes tightly around the finger of those monks who are tempted to
deviate from their vows.  We are told that married elves have been
known to give the ring to their spouses when about to embark on a long
adventure which will keep them apart.

Objects.Name: book dragon
Objects.Description:
"The Complete Dragon", by Edward Cewmriskpyltk, famous gnomish
scientist, is yours for the taking.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dragons breed and raise their young in deep underground caves.  They
live in large clans headed by a female and her group of male consorts.
Many eggs are laid and kept protected in the dragon hatchery.  When
they hatch, the young are soft, fuzzy pale colors, and they are unable
to fly, breathe fire or do any of the very nasty tricks that older
dragons learn.  For this, they must go to dragon school, run by the
dragon master.

As they grow older, the rapidly enlarging dragons shed their skin many
times.  With each molt their color grows deeper and richer  until they
finally achieve the jewel tones so favored by adult dragons.

Dragons are known to gather and hoard the treasures of the earth -
precious and semi-precious jewels, gold and silver.  The adventurer
finding the grand dragon's jewels would truly be wealthy for life.

Dragons are a happy group, by and large, with a very strong sense of
humor.  When they swoop down upon a defenseless village and burn it to
the ground they do so not from any evil purpose, but just from the
sheer joy of it.

Objects.Name: white boots
Objects.Description: A pair of highly polished white boots stands smartly at attention.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elven guards work hard to keep these white boots gleaming and
highly polished.  Working in the midst of a forest and a dirt road,
this takes a lot of work.  Made of thick leather with pointed toecaps
of mithril, these boots are not strictly ornamental

Objects.Name: white linen loincloth
Objects.Description: A length of white linen sits neatly folded on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A length of white linen has been woven just long enough to be wrapped
around your waist as a loincloth.  The linen is finely woven, of elven
origin.

Objects.Name: wine bottle
Objects.ShortDescription: a gracefully curved bottle of dark red wine
Objects.Description: A rather large bottle of a deep red wine might be too heavy to pick up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wiccan monks get their wine bottles from many sources.  This
particular one was brought back by a party of adventurers who went
troll hunting.  The bottle was, of course, thoroughly washed before
being used.  The bottle is quite large and has a very unusual shape.  A
very large round bottom leads to a long slender neck with a swanlike
curve.  The curve of the neck makes the bottle a bit tricky to handle.

Objects.Name: boots heels
Objects.ShortDescription: boots with very sharp high heels
Objects.Description:
A dainty pair of boots with very sharp high heels made of crystal look
a bit uncomfortable to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These boots were made for looks more than for combat wear.
Nevertheless, those 4" (10cm) sharp heels could do some real damage!
They are a clear crystal, unlike the rest of the boot, which is a very
soft black leather.

Objects.Name: bandana forest green
Objects.Description:
The forest green bandana is the symbol of the FTE, the Free the Elves
radical group.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bandana has become a symbol, a sign of affiliation with a
particular group.  Green, of course, is the color of the elven
radicals.

Objects.Name: hot pink bandana
Objects.Description: A square of bright pink cloth leaps out at you from its resting place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The punk bunnies like the hot pink bandana because the color is so
bright, and because the elves loathe it.  Sometimes they pair it with a
banana yellow bandana, just to *poke* at the staid elves.

Objects.Name: banana yellow bandana
Objects.Description: Something the color of ripe bananas rests on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This cheerful yellow bandana carries a faint scent of bananas.  Whether
a result of the dye used or a magic spell, it is impossible to tell.

Objects.Name: black bandana
Objects.Description: A dusty black bandana lies here, folded into a neat triangle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Black is the color of the assassin's guild.  Wearing this bandana over
their evil faces they can more easily fade into the night.  Of course,
they look a little silly during daylight hours ...

Objects.Name: clean white bandana
Objects.Description: A clean white bandana might allow a worthy person to wear it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The good - or at least, well-meaning - monks of Tynstri wear this bandana
as a symbol of their good intentions and solid virtue.  Like the
celibacy ring of novice monks, the bandana has an unfortunate effect on
those who stray.

Objects.Name: cards  marked deck
Objects.Description: A well used deck of cards has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Wonder who slipped this deck into the poker room?  It has been cleverly
marked so that a card shark can tell at a glance which cards other
players are holding.  Pretty sneaky ...

Objects.Name: animal crackers
Objects.Description: A small box of animal crackers, decorated like a circus cage.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Small cookies in wildly imaginative shapes fill this very small box.

Objects.Name: dragon crackers
Objects.Description:
A bright box of spicy dragon cookies lies in ambush, waiting for some
sucker to take a bite.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rather spicy for a cookie, you need a strong stomach to swallow these
dragon crackers.  They are quite colorful, as are the dragons they
imitate.  There is something written on the box in tiny print.
Made especially for the elves by the dragons of Tynstri.

Objects.Name: stubby candle
Objects.Description: A stub of a candle has been left here in a pool of wax.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small stub of a candle has been stuck into a pool of wax.  Some
breath of air has blown it out.  Perhaps you should take it with you,
just in case!

Objects.Name: tree sign
Objects.Description:
A wooden sign has been brightly painted and nailed to a tree.  It
starts off  "Before you swing".

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before You Swing
                         
                          #RWarning#N:  Adult area!

                        Elves under 60 not permitted
 
                            unless accompanied 
                          
                         by a responsible adult.

Objects.Name: dragon egg eggs
Objects.Description: A very large jewel-bright egg glows.  What will it hatch?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some dragon has chosen to leave a precious egg here.  Dragon eggs 
come in many hues, but all are deep, rich, jewel tones.  Although
they take a long time to hatch, there is no way to tell (from the
outside) how soon this egg will crack.  Of course, the fact that it
seems to be rocking itself might give you a clue that whatever is 
inside is pretty big!

Objects.Name: medallion eye glob romeobj
Objects.Description: An ever-vigilant eye watches from its glowing red-orange background.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles that
have threaded their way into the heart of societies around the world.
New members are given this medallion or some other piece of body wear
bearing the Glob insignia.  They are told that it is a gift and a means
for them to identify themselves to others.  But they all experience a
feeling of being watched, ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society.  Perhaps it is best not to know too
much.
